item.title: High inflation to persist globally into next year, Reuters poll shows
item.description: High inflation will persist in the global economy well into next year, according to hundreds of economists polled by Reuters, who are now increasingly concerned that price pressures will become entrenched beyond rising energy costs caused by the conflict in the Middle East.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: High inflation will persist in the global economy well into next year, according to hundreds of economists polled by Reuters, who are now increasingly concerned that price pressures will become entrenched beyond rising energy costs caused by the conflict in the Middle East. More than $1 trillion of investment in artificial intelligence technology globally since last year has made some economies more resilient at a time when cost of living pressures are squeezing households and shaping national politics. Most central banks have raised interest rates only a few times or not at all, but more could come if inflation pressures broaden. A global rout in bond markets in recent months has also tightened financial conditions through higher yields. Crude oil [USN:L2N46D00J TEXT:"prices"], which have stayed above $100 a barrel since October 7, hit a six-month high of over $117 last week and are up more than 60% since the US-Israeli war with Iran began almost eight months ago. Even forecasters who did not anticipate a quick end to the war are now sounding more concerned about inflation resurgence, particularly given the resilience of global growth. More than 500 economists Reuters surveyed globally this month raised their 2027 inflation forecasts for 31 of the 50 economies polled on and growth forecasts for 23 of them. "I am getting much more concerned about inflation again," said Janet Henry, global chief economist at HSBC. "The longer the situation evolves and escalates in the Middle East and the higher the broad basket of price pressures builds, the greater the likelihood that we get not just higher but more persistent inflation." Economists raised 2027 inflation forecasts for 15 of 21 developed economies covered. That suggests inflation worries are spreading and affecting economies that typically experience low price pressures. Cumulatively, median forecasts for 2027 inflation over the past three quarterly polls have risen by 0.7 percentage points for [USN:L6N4610Q9 TEXT:"Britain"], 0.5 percentage points for the [USN:L6N45U0QU TEXT:"euro zone"] and only 0.2 percentage points so far for the US. They have risen by 0.4 percentage points for India and by 0.5 percentage point for [USN:L6N4650KO TEXT:"Brazil"]. "Higher energy prices continue to ripple through the global economy, but economic activity remains resilient, supported by the AI-led investment cycle and firmer-than-expected activity across several regions," Seth Carpenter, global chief economist at Morgan Stanley, said in a note. "The inflation picture has become more complex as signs of energy pass-through into core measures are beginning to emerge." The effects of rising prices on household budgets have taken centre stage in various political campaigns across the world. Opinion polls show voters ahead of US midterm elections on November 3 are preoccupied with these issues and Brazil's presidential [USN:L2N46B01X TEXT:"election"], which gave incumbent Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva his fourth non-consecutive term, was also fought on cost of living issues. In contrast to two previous polls in April and July, which painted a weak-growth, high-inflation scenario, the latest forecasts lean towards one where price pressures accompany more robust economic performance. Economists upgraded their global growth forecasts for both this year and next, to 3.0% and 3.2%, respectively, from 2.9% and 3.1% in the July poll, though the 2027 forecast is lower than the 3.4% the International Monetary Fund is predicting. The US, which [USN:L6N46606V TEXT:"leads"] in AI capital expenditure that has now become the main driver of domestic growth, is forecast to expand 2.3% this year and 2.1% in 2027. ([USN:L6N45N0UX TEXT:"Other stories"] from the Reuters global economic poll)

item.title: Pedidos de bienes duraderos en EE.UU. suben 1,8% en septiembre por repunte de aviones
item.description: Los pedidos aumentaron un 1,8% en septiembre, impulsados por un alza del 28,4% en las órdenes de aviones comerciales. Los pedidos de bienes de capital básicos crecieron un 0,5%.
item.dc:creator: Jeffrey Sparshott
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Los pedidos de bienes duraderos en Estados Unidos registraron en septiembre su mayor aumento en cinco meses, impulsados por el incremento de los pedidos de aeronaves y otros equipos empresariales, lo que se suma a los indicios de dinamismo en el sector manufacturero. El valor de los pedidos de bienes duraderos —destinados a durar al menos tres años— aumentó un 1,8% tras un incremento del 0,1% (revisado al alza) registrado el mes anterior, según las cifras publicadas este martes por el Departamento de Comercio. La previsión media de una encuesta de Bloomberg a economistas apuntaba a un avance del 1,9%. Ver más: Si los latinos en Estados Unidos fueran un país, superarían el PIB de estas potencias mundiales Los pedidos de bienes de capital básicos —un indicador de la inversión en equipamiento que excluye las categorías volátiles de aeronaves y material militar— aumentaron un 0,5% el mes pasado. El informe sobre bienes duraderos reveló un aumento del 28,4% en los pedidos de aviones comerciales. Boeing Co. ( BA ) registró más pedidos en septiembre en comparación con el mes anterior. Los pedidos de ordenadores, maquinaria y vehículos de motor también aumentaron. La inversión empresarial se ha mostrado sólida este año, impulsada por el gasto relacionado con la inteligencia artificial. El informe sobre bienes duraderos sugiere que esa tendencia se mantuvo durante septiembre, lo que allana el camino para una cifra sólida de gasto de capital cuando el Gobierno publique el jueves su estimación inicial del producto interior bruto del tercer trimestre. Los envíos de bienes de capital no destinados a la defensa, incluidas las aeronaves —que se tienen en cuenta en la partida de inversión en equipamiento del informe del PIB—, aumentaron un 1,7%. El Gobierno utiliza los datos sobre envíos como dato de entrada para el PIB, en lugar de los pedidos, que pueden cancelarse. Ver más: Los costes por intereses en EE.UU. alcanzan la cifra récord de US$1 billón, lo que supone un riesgo de que la deuda se dispare Antes de la publicación del informe, la previsión GDPNow del Banco de la Reserva Federal de Atlanta anticipaba que el gasto empresarial en equipamiento añadiría un punto porcentual al crecimiento del tercer trimestre. Los envíos de bienes de capital subyacentes —un indicador menos volátil que excluye aviones y material militar— aumentaron un 1,2%, prolongando así una racha de sólidos avances. Los economistas prefieren la cifra de envíos de bienes de capital básicos para evaluar la inversión de capital subyacente, ya que transcurre un tiempo extremadamente largo entre el pedido de aeronaves y material militar y el envío efectivo de los mismos. -Con la colaboración de Mark Niquette. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: Boeing registra pérdidas de US$697 millones en su división comercial pese al alza de ingresos
item.description: Los problemas de suministro y el estancamiento de las entregas afectaron los resultados de la división comercial, mientras Boeing busca aumentar la producción del 737 Max y preparar la entrega del 777 ...
item.dc:creator: Will Guisbond
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Boeing Co. ( BA ) registró unas pérdidas mayores de lo previsto en su principal división de aviones comerciales, debido al estancamiento de las entregas durante el tercer trimestre y al aumento del gasto por parte de la empresa para respaldar futuros incrementos de la producción. La división de aviones comerciales, la mayor de Boeing en términos de ingresos, registró unas pérdidas de US$697 millones en dicho periodo, frente al déficit de US$360,8 millones previsto por los analistas consultados por Bloomberg. No obstante, la cifra representó solo una fracción de la pérdida registrada un año antes, cuando Boeing contabilizó un cargo de US$4.900 millones por el retraso en su programa del avión de fuselaje ancho 777-9. Las ganancias aumentaron en la división de defensa y espacio, en parte gracias a la venta de un laboratorio de investigación del que Boeing había sido copropietaria durante más de dos décadas, además del aumento del gasto mundial en defensa, que impulsó un mayor volumen de negocio. Ver más: Boeing obtiene la aprobación de EE.UU. para su avión 737 Max 10 tras años de retrasos Los resultados divergentes de las divisiones comercial y de defensa de Boeing ponen de relieve los complejos retos a los que se enfrentan el CEO, Kelly Ortberg, y su equipo para reflotar al gigante aeroespacial estadounidense, cuya salud financiera se ha visto afectada por una serie de crisis de calidad y seguridad durante la última década, incluidos varios accidentes mortales. La acción subió hasta un 1,4% en las operaciones previas a la apertura del mercado el martes. Boeing ha caído un 13% este año, lo que sitúa a la empresa en camino de registrar su segundo peor rendimiento anual en cinco años. Boeing reiteró su intención de comenzar a entregar su avión de fuselaje ancho 777-9 el próximo año —lo que supone un retraso de unos seis años respecto al calendario previsto— y de aumentar la producción de su avión de pasillo único 737 Max, su principal fuente de ingresos. Ver más: Acciones de Boeing se desploman 26% desde enero, pero Wall Street mantiene su apuesta por la recuperación “De cara al futuro, las expectativas están aumentando, y así debe ser”, afirmó Ortberg en un mensaje dirigido a los empleados el martes. “Contamos con una base más sólida que hace un año, pero también nos queda más trabajo por hacer para cumplir con nuestra cartera de pedidos, reforzar nuestra cultura y mejorar nuestra forma de trabajar cada día”. El flujo de caja libre del tercer trimestre ascendió a US$464 millones, superando las estimaciones de los analistas, que se situaban en US$325,1 millones. En conjunto, la empresa registró una pérdida subyacente de 34 céntimos por acción, superior a los 21 céntimos estimados. Los ingresos totales aumentaron un 4%, hasta alcanzar los US$24.200 millones, superando las previsiones. Desde la llegada de Ortberg en 2024, el fabricante de aviones con sede en Arlington (Virginia) ha estado trabajando para sanear su balance, lastrado por la deuda, recuperar la confianza de los reguladores e impulsar la producción de sus modelos de aviones comerciales más importantes. La empresa comunicó el martes que dispone de US$10.000 millones en líneas de crédito no utilizadas. La deuda consolidada se mantuvo sin cambios en US$45.900 millones con respecto a los tres meses anteriores. El CEO ha vendido una serie de activos no esenciales, desprendiéndose este trimestre de HRL Laboratories. Desde entonces, Wall Street se ha mostrado más optimista con respecto al fabricante, aunque los problemas de la cadena de suministro y de producción lastran sus planes de aumentar la producción. Ver más: FAA determina que fallo del Boeing 737 Max no representa un riesgo para la seguridad Los problemas con la entrega de motores, en particular, han frenado el aumento del ritmo de producción del 737 Max y del 787 Dreamliner. En septiembre, Ortberg afirmó que Boeing aún no había alcanzado el “rendimiento en la entrega de motores” necesario para producir diez aviones 787 al mes, frente al ritmo actual de ocho. El fabricante de aviones afirmó el martes que sigue trabajando para estabilizar la producción de aviones 737 Max en 47 al mes. Los resultados del tercer trimestre de Boeing se dan a conocer un día antes de que su rival, Airbus SE, publique sus propios resultados financieros. Airbus ha superado a Boeing en entregas de aviones, pero el fabricante franco-alemán tampoco se ha librado este año de sus propios contratiempos en materia de calidad y suministro. -Con la colaboración de Siddharth Philip. FAST

Oct 27 : The away supporter entrance to third-tier side Rot-Weiss Essen's stadium was discovered sealed shut with concrete hours ahead of their German Cup second-round match against Bundesliga club RB Leipzig, regional newspaper WAZ reported on Tuesday. Concrete had been poured into a wooden frame linking two entrance gates, preventing them from opening, the report said. Workers from the west German city Essen between Dortmund and Dusseldorf were brought in to dismantle the barricade. "The bulls must stay outside today," read a message at the barricade. No arrests have been reported. Around 550 Leipzig supporters are expected at the Stadion an der Hafenstrasse for the match later on Tuesday.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Coca-Cola raises profit forecast as premium drinks, sodas hold strong
item.description: Coca-Cola has lifted its annual profit forecast, driven by robust demand for a range of beverages, particularly zero-sugar options. The company now anticipates earnings per share growth of at least 9% by 2026. Their third-quarter revenue soared to $13.38 billion, exceeding analysts' expectations, while Coca-Cola's strong showing stands in sharp contrast to PepsiCo's recent downgrades and cost-cutting plans. Following these promising results, Coca-Cola shares rose nearly 1% in premarket trading.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Coca-Cola on Tuesday raised its annual profit forecast, betting on resilient demand for its zero-sugar sodas and pricier beverages such as fairlife milk and sparkling soft drinks.The company now expects comparable currency-neutral earnings per share to grow at least 9% in 2026, up from its previous forecast of 7% to 8%.Coca-Cola's third-quarter revenue rose 7.4% to $13.38 billion, beating analysts' estimate of $12.92 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG.As high food and fuel prices make consumers more selective, Coca-Cola has sought to sustain demand by offering smaller, cheaper packs while rolling out pricier new flavours such as Coca-Cola Cherry Float.The company also benefited from demand during the soccer World Cup in July, including a brief sales boost for its energy drink brands.Its performance contrasts with rival PepsiCo, which lowered its annual targets earlier this month and stepped up cost cuts as it grapples with weak demand for snacks in North America.Coca-Cola shares rose nearly 1% in premarket trading. The stock has jumped about 33% in 2026 and is on track for a third straight year of gains, despite broader weakness in consumer spending and market volatility stemming from the war in Iran.

item.title: Ibovespa segue fragilizado com investidor atento a sinal fiscal após tombo com reeleição de Lula
item.description: A bolsa paulista ensaiou uma acomodação nesta terça-feira, mas o Ibovespa voltava a trabalhar com sinal negativo, um dia depois de forte reprecificação dos ativos brasileiros na véspera, que acionou o "circuit breaker" no pregão, na esteira da reeleição do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.
item.dc:creator: Paula Arend Laier
item.content:encoded: A bolsa paulista ensaiou uma acomodação nesta terça-feira, mas o Ibovespa voltava a trabalhar com sinal negativo, um dia depois de forte reprecificação dos ativos brasileiros na véspera, que acionou o "circuit breaker" no pregão, na esteira da reeleição do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. Por volta de 11h10, o Ibovespa (.BVSP) , referência do mercado acionário brasileiro, recuava 0,82%, a 175.156,77 pontos, tendo alcançado 178.526,08 pontos na máxima até o momento. O volume financeiro no pregão brasileiro somava R$21,57 bilhões. Na segunda-feira, o Ibovespa [USN:S0N450028 TEXT:"caiu"] 13,88%, maior queda desde 2020, uma vez que o desfecho da eleição contrariou expectativas no mercado de vitória do senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) e uma possível agenda econômica mais favorável ao ajuste fiscal. De acordo com levantamento da Elos Ayta, o valor de mercado consolidado das empresas listadas na B3 registrou uma queda de R$734 bilhões na segunda-feira. Para o responsável pela área de renda variável da Criteria, Thiago Pedroso, parte da queda da segunda-feira pode ser explicada pelo desmonte acelerado de posições (com o resultado contrariando expectativas), e não necessariamente por uma deterioração equivalente dos fundamentos econômicos. "A preocupação estrutural, entretanto, permanece", afirmou em comentário a clientes no começo desta terça-feira, destacando que o principal desafio do novo mandato será recuperar a credibilidade fiscal. "A trajetória da dívida pública, a rigidez das despesas obrigatórias e a necessidade de resultados primários mais consistentes continuarão limitando o espaço para a redução sustentável dos juros." Em Brasília, o ministro da Fazenda, Dario Durigan, afirmou mais cedo que reafirmou a Lula a necessidade de dar uma [USN:L2N46D0LK TEXT:"sinalização"] propositiva ao mercado e que o governo já tem medidas prontas para apresentação, incluindo a que permite a busca do centro da meta fiscal. DESTAQUES VALE ON (VALE3.SA) recuava 1,55%, em meio ao declínio dos futuros do minério de ferro na China, onde o contrato mais negociado na Bolsa de Mercadorias de Dalian fechou o pregão diurno com queda de 0,9%. Também no radar está o balanço da mineradora do terceiro trimestre, previsto para quinta-feira, após o fechamento do mercado. PETROBRAS PN caía 1,21%, com a fraqueza do petróleo no exterior também no radar. O barril do Brent mostrava queda de 1,29%, a US$114,32. O Goldman Sachs prevê que a Petrobras deverá manter os [USN:L6N46D0VL TEXT:"preços do diesel"] vendido a distribuidoras inalterados até o fim do ano, após o governo brasileiro ter decidido prorrogar por mais 30 dias os subsídios ao combustível. BANCO DO BRASIL ON (BBAS3.SA) subia 0,92%, experimentando uma trégua após fechar com um tombo de mais de 29% na véspera, embora tenha já reduzido o fôlego em relação aos primeiros negócios, quando chegou a avançar 4,8%. BRADESCO PN mostrava decréscimo de 0,75%, ITAÚ UNIBANCO PN perdia 0,98%, BTG PACTUAL UNIT recuava 2,23% e SANTANDER BRASIL UNIT caía 2,24%, com o setor como um todo perdendo força após uma abertura mais positiva. O Citi rebaixou as ações do BB para venda e do Bradesco para neutra, enquanto manteve Itaú e BTG com recomendação de compra. B3 ON (B3SA3.SA) avançava 1,66%, em sessão de ajustes. Na véspera, a ação fechou com um tombo superior a 36,28%, após afundar quase 50% no pior momento. Em Nova York, XP (XP.O) subia 1,6%, também refletindo ajustes após desabar mais de 48% na segunda-feira. Analistas do Citi cortaram a recomendação para ambos os papéis para "neutra", avaliando que juros mais altos e a incerteza fiscal devem continuar pressionando o apetite por risco, as entradas líquidas de recursos, a atividade de negociação e as emissões no mercado de capitais. "Embora a qualidade dos negócios permaneça sólida, vemos um ambiente operacional menos favorável." MAGAZINE LUIZA ON (MGLU3.SA) saltava 7,36%, em dia de correção, após afundar mais de 58% na segunda-feira. TENDA ON (TEND3.SA) subia 5,17%, também com ajustes, assim como DIRECIONAL ON (DIRR3.SA) , com elevação de 3,53%, endossadas ainda por relatório do JPMorgan, que elevou a recomendação de ambos os papéis para "overweight". CURY ON (CURY3.SA) , que também teve upgrade, mostrava acréscimo de 1,11%. Na contramão, MRV&CO ON (MRVE3.SA) recuava 5,5%, CYRELA ON (CYRE3.SA) caía 2,04% e EZTEC ON (EZTC3.SA) , que não faz parte do Ibovespa, perdia 7,68%. O JPMorgan manteve MRV&Co com recomendação neutra, mesma classificação que agora estabeleceu para Cyrela e Eztec -- que eram "overweight". GERDAU PN (GGBR4.SA) caía 1,26%, em pregão negativo no setor, com investidores também analisando o [USN:S0N46906J TEXT:"balanço"] da companhia no terceiro trimestre, com lucro líquido ajustado de R$1,52 bilhão, alta de 39,7% sobre o desempenho obtido no mesmo período do ano passado. O vice-presidente financeiro do grupo, Rafael Japur, disse nesta terça-feira que a principal operação da Gerdau, a América do Norte, deve ter [USN:L2N46D0LH TEXT:"volumes de venda menores"] no quarto trimestre, mas margem de lucro operacional estável ante os três meses imediatamente anteriores.

item.title: オレシュキで局地停戦開始、ロ・ウ双方が発表 キーウなどでは攻撃継続
item.description:
Dan Peleschuk Anna Voitenko
[キーウ ２７日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Dan Peleschuk　Anna Voitenko

[キーウ ２７日 ロイター] - ロシアとウクライナは２７日、ロシアが占領するウクライナ南部ヘルソン州オレシュキでの人道支援活動を可能にするため局地的な停戦を開始した。停戦により食料・医薬品不足が深刻なオレシュキへの支援物資搬入や住民の避難が可能になる。ただ、首都キーウなど他の地域では攻撃が続いている。

ロシアとウクライナはともに、前線に位置するオレシュ周辺での停戦を順守していると表明した。停戦はウクライナ時間午前３時（０１００ＧＭＴ、日本時間午前１０時）に発効し、１１月１日まで続く予定。

オレシュキは２０２２年２月からロシア占領下にあり、食料支援が滞るなどして住民の人道危機が深刻化。ホワイトハウスは先週、トランプ米大統領のメラニア夫人がオレシュキでの停戦実現に貢献したと発表した。

一方、キーウ市当局によると、２７日の新たな攻撃で市内の南橋と地下鉄インフラが被害を受けて通行や運行が停止、少なくとも１人が死亡した。

＜ロシアによる占領＞

オレシュキはウクライナ南部ヘルソン州のドニプロ川東岸に位置し、対岸にはウクライナ軍が支配するヘルソン市がある。ロシア軍は２２年２月の全面侵攻開始直後に制圧、支配を続けている。オレシュキは戦争での広範な被害のほか、２３年に付近のカホフカダムが破壊された際には、洪水でも甚大な被害を受けた。

米国によると、戦前２万４０００人だった人口は、現在わずか数千人に減っている。住民や当局者は、食料や医薬品、その他の生活必需品が深刻に不足していると報告。水道や電気、ガス、地域暖房の供給もほぼ途絶えている。食料や水を手に入れるだけのために住民は地雷が散在する道路を移動している状況だ。

ウクライナとロシアの当局者は、支援物資の搬入と住民の移動を可能にする人道回廊を設置すると表明。道路の地雷除去が必要になるとみられ、数日かかる可能性がある。

ウクライナとロシアは、オレシュキの人道危機の責任を互いに非難している。民間人にとって最大の脅威はドローンで、同市は両軍の無人機が容易に到達できる範囲にある。

＜キーウに新たな攻撃＞

ロシアによる夜間の攻撃ではキーウの重要な橋である南橋が被害を受けた。ゼレンスキー氏は、ウクライナの物流網に対する「攻撃の深刻な激化」だと述べた。ウクライナ軍関係者によると、南橋には弾道ミサイル「イスカンデル」４発が命中した。

ゼレンスキー氏によると、ほかの１０地域でも夜間にエネルギー施設や物流拠点、インフラが攻撃された。

ロシア国防省は、軍事目標を狙った攻撃で、キーウの交通インフラ、ハルキウ州の物流拠点のほか、産業施設や貨物船を攻撃したと発表した。

ロシアでは、ウクライナとの国境に近い西部ブリャンスク市でドローン攻撃により１人が死亡したと当局が発表した。ウクライナのザポリージャ州のロシア支配地域ではバスが攻撃され、当局者によると１人が死亡、３０人が負傷した。

item.description: Lula asumirá en enero su cuarto mandato con un déficit superior al 8% del PIB y una deuda sobre 80%, mientras el ajuste fiscal chocará con límites políticos y del Congreso.
item.dc:creator: Juan Pablo Álvarez
item.content:encoded: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva comenzará en enero su cuarto mandato al frente de Brasil tras derrotar al senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), en un escenario en el que el ajuste fiscal aparece como una necesidad independientemente del resultado electoral. El próximo gobierno deberá enfrentar un déficit presupuestario superior al 8% del PIB y una deuda pública que ya supera el 80% del producto, según Fitch Ratings. La calificadora espera que Brasil endurezca su política fiscal en 2027 y advierte que esa consolidación será uno de los factores que pesarán sobre la actividad económica. Felipe Salto, economista jefe y socio de Warren Rena, había dialogado con Bloomberg Línea previo a la elección y señaló había dicho que el ajuste fiscal era inevitable tanto para Lula como para Flávio. Ahora, con la elección definida, el desafío del presidente será convertir esa necesidad en medidas políticamente viables y conseguir el respaldo del Congreso. VER MÁS: Brasil necesita un ajuste fiscal gane Lula o Bolsonaro y el Congreso será el reto, advierte economista La situación de partida será peor que la prevista en el presupuesto. Warren calcula que las medidas anunciadas en la recta final de la campaña tendrán un impacto potencial de entre 45.000 millones de reales (US$8.900 millones) y 47.000 millones de reales (US$9.300 millones) en 2027. El cálculo incluye el cambio en el límite de ingresos del microempresario individual (MEI), la renegociación de las deudas bancarias del programa Desenrola 3.0, la condonación de deudas tributarias de los MEI, la beca para estudiantes universitarios, el reajuste de Bolsa Família y la pérdida de ingresos derivada de la prohibición de las apuestas. Al mismo tiempo, el proyecto de presupuesto para 2027 prevé un superávit primario de 0,1% del PIB. Salto considera que ese resultado no es posible y proyecta un déficit de 0,4%, frente al 0,38% que estima para 2026. El economista cuestiona además la estimación de ingresos por la CBS, el impuesto federal creado por la reforma tributaria, cuyo tipo impositivo todavía depende del cálculo del Tribunal de Cuentas de la Unión (TCU) y de la aprobación del Senado. Más del 90% del gasto primario federal es obligatorio, mientras que el gasto verdaderamente discrecional representa alrededor de 0,3% del PIB, según Emanoelle Santos, analista de mercados de XTB. Por eso, un ajuste de mayor alcance no pasaría simplemente por cerrar ministerios o reducir gastos administrativos. La discusión tendría que alcanzar cuestiones estructurales como la indexación de beneficios, el gasto previsional, el salario mínimo, los pisos constitucionales, las exenciones tributarias y la eficiencia del gasto público. Salto propone un ajuste gradual, debido al riesgo de recesión y a las dificultades políticas. En su propuesta junto con el economista Josué Pellegrini, el límite de crecimiento real del gasto dentro del marco fiscal bajaría del 2,5% al 1%, mientras que los mínimos de salud y educación quedarían sujetos a ese límite. La iniciativa también plantea desvincular el reajuste de las pensiones del salario mínimo y modificar los sistemas de pensiones rural y de los militares. El reajuste real de las prestaciones sería definido cada año por el Poder Ejecutivo y financiado prioritariamente con recursos de las enmiendas parlamentarias, que superan los 50.000 millones de reales (US$9.890 millones). Ese será uno de los principales desafíos del cuarto mandato. La consolidación fiscal requiere cambios que exceden la capacidad de decisión unilateral del Poder Ejecutivo. “La próxima presidente recibirá un problema que es bastante más estructural y que además necesita al Congreso para resolverlo”, había advertido Emanoelle Santos antes del balotaje. Por su parte, Salto también había señalado que la capacidad de Lula para coordinarse con el centro tendrá que ser mucho mayor que durante su tercer mandato. El ajuste fiscal llegará mientras la economía brasileña ya pierde dinamismo. Entre enero y agosto de 2026 creció 1,5% interanual, frente a un promedio de 3% durante los cuatro años anteriores. Fitch proyecta una expansión del PIB de 1,9% en 2026 y de 1,4% en 2027. Las tasas de interés reales elevadas ya están afectando el consumo y la inversión, mientras que el ratio de servicio de la deuda del sector privado se encuentra en su nivel más alto en dos décadas. La calificadora espera que la Selic baje desde 13,75% hasta 11,75% para fines de 2027, aunque considera que el Banco Central mantendrá tasas reales elevadas debido a las expectativas de inflación y a la persistencia de una inflación de servicios alta. Un ajuste fiscal significativo podría acelerar la reducción de las tasas y contribuir a bajar los intereses de más largo plazo. Pero, al mismo tiempo, una consolidación fiscal más estricta será otro lastre para una economía que ya enfrenta una desaceleración. Salto sostuvo que Brasil no enfrenta una crisis de solvencia: destaca la caja del Tesoro, de entre 1,2 billones y 1,3 billones de reales, las reservas internacionales y el hecho de que la deuda está concentrada en reales. Pero la deuda bruta ya representa 82,9% del PIB y continúa aumentando, mientras que el gasto público crece a un ritmo dos veces y media superior al PIB en términos reales. Para Salto, no hay margen para evitar indefinidamente las decisiones difíciles. “No se le puede mentir a la población. Habrá que tomar algunas medidas y estas tendrán costos a corto plazo”. El objetivo, según su propuesta, sería conseguir tasas de interés más bajas y un crecimiento sostenido, en lugar de un “crecimiento efímero”. El desafío para Lula, ya con la elección ganada, será determinar cuánto de ese ajuste puede transformar en política económica y cuánto de la agenda requerirá negociar con el Congreso.

item.title: JetBlue shares rally after airline flags "disconnect" between earnings and bond rout
item.description: JetBlue Airways extended its early gains to surge 20% on Tuesday, after the airline said there was "a significant disconnect" between its third-quarter earnings and a recent bond sell-off.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: JetBlue Airways (JBLU.O) extended its early gains to surge 20% on Tuesday, after the airline said there was "a significant disconnect" between its third-quarter earnings and a recent bond sell-off. The carrier raised its full-year seat revenue growth forecast to 13.5%-14.5% from 10%-12.5%, banking on strong fares and growth in Fort Lauderdale, but flagged fuel costs as a drag. It also ended the quarter with $2.2 billion in liquidity, including a $600 million undrawn credit facility, and about $7 billion in unencumbered assets — $2.8 billion of which are aircraft and engines, following updated appraisals. "I think there's a significant disconnect between the narrative and the bond market and what our financial results are demonstrating," JetBlue CEO Joanna Geraghty told analysts, pointing to the financial flexibility to bridge to the 2028 EPS goal. JetBlue's TrueBlue senior secured note, a bond backed by the airline's loyalty program, came under heavy selling pressure this month, with the price halving to about $47 and yields surging to distressed levels above 30% as of October 26. The industry's quarter was weighed down by surging fuel prices tied to the ongoing war in Iran, which has forced airlines to take measures such as raising fares, cutting [USN:L4N46813M TEXT:"capacity"] or taking on more debt. The fuel headwinds, along with weather and air traffic control disruptions earlier this year, have wiped away roughly 48% of JetBlue's share value, dropping its valuation to $894.23 million and making it the worst-performing US carrier. "Liquidity and $2.8 billion of aircraft assets could provide runway, but the path to profitability hinges on fuel," analysts at TD Cowen said. Fuel costs surged for JetBlue in the third quarter, with the airline paying $3.91 per gallon, up 57% from a year earlier. By comparison, unit revenue increased 18.4%, highlighting the pressure rising fuel expenses continue to place on margins despite stronger pricing. Short interest in the stock is currently at 25%.

item.title: India Deploys Extra Forces After Protests Over Dam on Chinese Border Escalate
item.description: By Tora Agarwala India has deployed hundreds of additional security personnel in its remote northeast, authorities said on Tuesday, after youth protesters clashed with police last week over a plan to build a mega-dam to counter a Chinese hydropower project upstream. Protests in Arunachal Pradesh’s …
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded:
By Tora Agarwala

India has deployed hundreds of additional security personnel in its remote northeast, authorities said on Tuesday, after youth protesters clashed with police last week over a plan to build a mega-dam to counter a Chinese hydropower project upstream.

Protests in Arunachal Pradesh’s Siang Valley, which borders Tibet, turned violent last week, triggering clashes with police, who made at least 21 arrests.

Police fired tear gas shells, while youth protesters pelted stones and set fire to a police station and an office of the state-owned National Hydroelectric Power Corporation, authorities said.

“Forces are being increased in the places where it is required. We do not want any law and order problem,” SD Singh Jamwal, police chief of Arunachal Pradesh, told Reuters.

Sporadic protests have taken place in the Siang Valley over the last two years, home to the proposed 11,200-megawatt Siang Upper Multipurpose Project, which will be developed by the state-run National Hydroelectric Power Corporation.

Villagers who oppose the project fear that the dam would submerge ancestral villages belonging to the Adi tribe.

“We will keep opposing this dam till they cancel it. If it is constructed, 27 of our ancestral villages will be completely submerged. At least 40 or 50 more will be affected,” Gegong Jijong of the Siang Indigenous Farmers’ Forum told Reuters.

The Siang River flows into Arunachal Pradesh from Tibet, where it is known as the Yarlung Zangbo. China announced plans in December 2024 to build the world’s largest hydropower dam upstream, triggering fears in New Delhi that its longtime strategic rival could weaponize its control of the river.

China claims Arunachal Pradesh, which it calls Zangnan, as part of southern Tibet. India says the state is an integral and inalienable part of its territory.

Arunachal Pradesh’s chief minister, a member of Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s Bharatiya Janata Party, has called the Chinese project an existential threat and said the government would protect national interests while respecting the rights and aspirations of the people of Siang Valley.

item.title: Artiva to discontinue cell therapy after two patient deaths, cut workforce by 94%
item.description: Artiva Biotherapeutics said on Tuesday it would halt the development of an experimental cell therapy for certain autoimmune conditions — its lead candidate — after two patient deaths, sending its shares slumping 32%.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Artiva Biotherapeutics (ARTV.O) said on Tuesday it would halt the development of an experimental cell therapy for certain autoimmune conditions — its lead candidate — after two patient deaths, sending its shares slumping 32%. The company will slash its workforce by about 94% and evaluate strategic alternatives, it said. Here are more details: Artiva's therapy AlloNK was being tested as a potential treatment for autoimmune conditions such as rheumatoid arthritis in a mid-stage trial The company said one of the patients in the trial experienced a fatal neurological event following treatment The investigator and an independent safety review assessed the event as likely related to complications caused by the chemotherapy drug fludarabine, the company said A second patient in the trial experienced sudden death about two months after initiating treatment, which an investigator assessed as unrelated to AlloNK, Artiva added "Two patient deaths plus fading durability quickly transformed what looked like a promising and differentiated path forward into one that carried too much risk and uncertainty," said Cantor Fitzgerald analyst Josh Schimmer Schimmer said a path forward with AlloNK would have been a challenging one with an incredibly high cost of capital As of September 30, Artiva had about $319.1 million in cash, cash equivalents and investments As of December 31, 2025, the company had 104 full-time employees, according to its annual filing

FAST

MANCHESTER, England, Oct 27 : Michael Carrick remained in charge of Manchester United on Tuesday and led training at Carrington, giving the under-pressure manager and his players another opportunity to revive a season that has drifted alarmingly off course. Carrick's future had appeared in serious doubt after Sunday's 3-0 home defeat by Bournemouth extended United's winless run to eight matches in all competitions and left them hovering one point above the Premier League relegation zone in 16th place. Senior club officials held talks on Monday amid mounting speculation over Carrick's position, with potential replacements already being linked to the job by British media reports. However, no decision was announced and the former United midfielder reported for work as normal, overseeing preparations for Saturday's league trip to Chelsea.

A club source said Carrick and his players will have the opportunity to turn the situation around, with the club focused on preparing for Saturday and showing a response on the pitch. Amid Sunday's frustration at Old Trafford, supporters levelled their anger at the players rather than the manager. As Carrick made his way towards the tunnel after the final whistle, thousands of fans sang his name and applauded him. The mood shifted seconds later when cheers turned to angry boos as the players made their way off the pitch. The scene was a reflection of the goodwill the 45-year-old Carrick still enjoys among a fanbase that remembers both his decorated 12-year playing career at United and the measured manner in which he has carried himself. He has repeatedly accepted responsibility for the team's struggles while shielding his players from scrutiny. "I totally understand the situation," he said after Sunday's loss. "I'm not expecting anything in particular, to be honest. I'm carrying on as normal, and I love this place. "I always do what I feel is going to be the best for the football club, whatever decision is made on anything really." Carrick turned around United's season when he replaced Ruben Amorim in January, guiding them to third in the league, but they have not won in the top flight this season since they beat newly promoted Ipswich Town on August 30. The pressure on Carrick was intensified last week by his decision to leave captain Bruno Fernandes on the bench four days after the Portugal midfielder publicly criticised United's tactics following a 4-1 Champions League loss at Como. Fans have also aimed their anger at the club's hierarchy in part-owner Jim Ratcliffe, chief executive officer Omar Berrada and director of football Jason Wilcox. United face a tough string of games in fifth-placed Chelsea, followed by AS Roma (Champions League), Aston Villa and Liverpool. Carrick is United's seventh permanent manager since Alex Ferguson retired in 2013. Eddie Howe and Julian Nagelsmann have featured prominently on the list of potential replacements.

Source: Reuters

item.title: BC diz que estuda medidas para conter endividamento com foco em crédito de maior risco
item.description: O Banco Central estuda adotar medidas macroprudenciais voltadas a segmentos de crédito de maior risco, afirmou a autoridade monetária em relatório divulgado nesta terça-feira, citando experiências internacionais de reforço na avaliação sobre a capacidade de pagamento das pessoas que contraem dívidas.
item.dc:creator: Bernardo Caram
item.content:encoded: O Banco Central estuda adotar medidas macroprudenciais voltadas a segmentos de crédito de maior risco, afirmou a autoridade monetária em relatório divulgado nesta terça-feira, citando experiências internacionais de reforço na avaliação sobre a capacidade de pagamento das pessoas que contraem dívidas. Em entrevista à imprensa, o presidente da autarquia, Gabriel Galípolo, ressaltou que a instituição pretende anunciar novas medidas sobre crédito ainda neste ano e destacou preocupação com linhas de financiamento sem garantia. "A gente se debruçou, estudou as experiências internacionais e vem observando que a questão comportamental, de experiência do cliente e de como isso é ofertado têm um peso muito grande nesse processo, são com essas linhas que estamos bastante preocupados e mirando os próximos passos", disse. Na mesma entrevista, o diretor de Fiscalização do BC, Ailton de Aquino, citou preocupação com cartões de crédito e outras linhas de crédito não garantido. Em seu Relatório de Estabilidade Financeira, publicação semestral, a autoridade monetária ressaltou que as medidas em avaliação têm o objetivo de reduzir o superendividamento e fortalecer a sustentabilidade do crédito e a resiliência do sistema financeiro nacional. O BC apontou que pesquisa da autarquia indica que a crescente digitalização dos serviços financeiros tem ampliado significativamente a exposição de consumidores de menor renda a ofertas, contribuindo para intensificar o endividamento, tema que é "fonte relevante de preocupação para o BC e para o mercado financeiro". "Diversos países já utilizam medidas macroprudenciais para mitigar as vulnerabilidades dos tomadores, buscando reforçar a resiliência das famílias ao longo do ciclo financeiro", disse o BC no documento. Segundo a autarquia, nesse processo o desafio é capturar as diferentes dimensões das vulnerabilidades dos tomadores de crédito para subsidiar o desenho de instrumentos adequados. Nesse sentido, uma tendência comum é a crescente incorporação da situação financeira e da capacidade de pagamento dos tomadores ao monitoramento da estabilidade financeira. O presidente do BC, Gabriel Galípolo, tem destacado a preocupação com os níveis de endividamento no país, ressaltando a importância da promoção do uso responsável dos instrumentos de crédito e do devido provisionamento por parte dos bancos. Em agosto já havia afirmado que o BC estava avaliando experiências internacionais de medidas macroprudenciais. A [USN:L1N4650WU TEXT:"Reuters"] mostrou na semana passada que o conjunto de ações em preparação pelo BC começaria por medidas de prevenção e transparência, enquanto a autarquia ainda analisa modelo regulatório que poderá limitar o crédito autorizado por pessoa a depender do nível de renda --sistema usado por Cingapura. O plano foi iniciado três dias depois, quando o BC [USN:L1N46916M TEXT:"aprovou"] três resoluções sobre as responsabilidades de instituições financeiras na oferta e concessão de crédito, com novas salvaguardas contra ofertas inadequadas ou abusivas e maior transparência antes da contratação. Em seu relatório, a autarquia citou avaliação do Fundo Monetário Internacional (FMI) sobre o Brasil na qual a instituição enfatiza que a análise do endividamento das famílias deve ir além da inadimplência e considerar também a capacidade dos tomadores de absorver choques, destacando indicadores como a relação entre o serviço da dívida e a renda da pessoa. "Riscos associados à concessão de crédito incompatível com a situação financeira dos consumidores demonstram a necessidade de ampla coordenação para evitar o superendividamento das famílias", disse. No documento, a autarquia mencionou o sistema de Cingapura, que limita o comprometimento da renda com o serviço da dívida e tem medidas para "restringir o acúmulo excessivo de dívida pelas famílias", bem como modelos de Canadá, Suécia, Coreia do Sul e Nova Zelândia, que têm exigências ou limitações na concessão de crédito. O BC apontou ainda que o apetite a risco das instituições financeiras mostrou sinais de redução no primeiro semestre, quando o financiamento à economia real desacelerou, e a perspectiva é de crédito ainda mais restritivo no segundo semestre. "O ambiente de juros contracionistas, elevado endividamento e maior materialização de risco requer cautela e diligência adicionais na concessão de crédito, tanto na qualidade das operações quanto no apetite ao risco", disse o BC. Segundo a autarquia, a despeito de as incertezas seguirem elevadas, não há risco relevante para a estabilidade financeira no país.

Former New Zealand PM Jacinda Ardern is now a professor at University of Sydney

Jacinda Ardern was elected as the prime minister of New Zealand when she was just 37. She served in the position from 2017 to 2023.

Nootan Sharma

27 October, 2026 05:30 pm IST

1

Facebook

Twitter

WhatsApp

Linkedin

Former New Zealand PM Jacinda Ardern | Reuters

Follow Us :

Text Size: A- A+

-->

New Delhi: F ormer New Zealand prime minister Jacinda Ardern has been appointed a lecturer at the University of Sydney. She will also work as a mentor. According to the university, she has been hired as a professor of practice and will focus on empathetic leadership, social cohesion, and civic trust.

Ardern will address global health challenges, inclusion, and well-being with new approaches and also give guest lectures and masterclasses. The university stated that the position will not be a full-time teaching role.

The former prime minister said she was hoping to “explore and develop ways to better serve our communities”.

Show Full Article

“I’ve found myself especially focused on the question of leadership since leaving office, and how we can better support and encourage the kind of leadership needed to tackle our many global challenges,” said Ardern.

‘Dame Jacinda, a thoughtful teacher’ Mark Scott, vice-chancellor and president at the University of Sydney, said that Ardern brings courage and humanity to public life.

“For our students, the opportunity to learn from Dame Jacinda is exceptional. They will meet not only a former Prime Minister but also a thoughtful teacher with a great deal to share about public leadership and service,” he said.

Jacinda Ardern was elected as the prime minister of New Zealand when she was just 37. She served in the position from 2017 to 2023.

During her tenure, she led the country through the Christchurch terrorist attack, the Whakaari White Island volcanic eruption, and the Covid-19 pandemic.

Ardern was awarded a damehood for her services to the state in 2023, a few months after she announced her surprise resignation as prime minister.

After leaving office, Ardern became a fellow at Harvard University, where she focused on leadership and technology. She has also continued advocating for action on online extremism and strengthening democratic institutions, drawing on her experience of crisis management and public service in New Zealand.

(Edited by Prasanna Bachchhav)

CAPE TOWN, Oct 27 : Opener Marques Ackerman struck a career-best 95 as South Africa reached 221 for four at tea on the first day of the decisive third and final test against Australia at Newlands on Tuesday. • Australia captain Pat Cummins won the toss and chose to field, only the 12th time a team has done so in tests at Newlands since 1889. Five of the previous 11 tests were won by the team electing to field. • Ackerman, 30, playing in his second test, and Aiden Markram (78) added 158 in 31.4 overs for the first wicket as they took the attack to Australia. • Ackerman was out when he danced down the wicket to spinner Nathan Lyon and was stumped five short of his century, a rash shot as he tried to go to his ton with a six.

They made four changes with Cameron Green, Josh Inglis, Connolly and Lyon coming into the side. • The series is level at 1-1 after Australia won the first test by 214 runs in Durban and South Africa responded with a victory by an innings and 31 runs in Gqeberha. • The team who win the match will occupy the number one position in the test world rankings, a position currently held by Australia.

FAST

NEW DELHI, Oct 27 : India plans to amend its anti-doping law to make peddling banned substances a crime, Sports Minister Mansukh Mandaviya said on Tuesday, in a potential boost to the country's bid to host the 2036 Olympic Games in Ahmedabad. India has topped the World Anti-Doping Agency's list of offenders for three consecutive years, underscoring the scale of the challenge facing the world's most populous nation. Speaking at a UNESCO anti-doping conference in New Delhi, Mandaviya stressed the ministry's zero tolerance towards "the menace of doping". "India firmly believes that sporting excellence must always be accompanied by integrity," he said.

"Every athlete deserves a fair opportunity to compete, with success determined by talent, preparation and hard work, and not by prohibited substances or methods." "We will also bring another amendment in the next session of our parliament, which aims to introduce criminal provisions to deal with violations even more effectively, including those by coaches and supply chain stakeholders." India also ranked among the top two nations for athletics' anti-doping rule violations between 2022 and 2025. That prompted the Athletics Integrity Unit board to move the Athletics Federation of India (AFI) from Category B to Category A.  Category A federations, deemed the highest risk, face stricter obligations, including minimum testing thresholds for national-team athletes. Local administrators often attribute the high number of cases to increased testing, but doping remains rampant due to easy availability of banned substances, inadequate safeguards and limited athlete awareness.  India's National Anti-Doping Agency conducted more than 7,000 tests and held over 350 awareness sessions for 27,000 athletes in the last two years, Mandaviya added.

item.title: PayPal raises 2026 profit forecast as turnaround gains traction
item.description: PayPal has raised its annual profit forecast as a multi-year turnaround begins to take effect. The company anticipates achieving significant cost savings through workforce reductions and operational efficiencies. Consumer spending remains strong despite economic challenges, aiding growth in payment volume. Additionally, PayPal expects adjusted profits in the upcoming holiday quarter to exceed Wall Street expectations. The focus on transformation under new leadership aims for sustainable profitability.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: PayPal lifted its annual adjusted profit forecast on Tuesday, as a years-long turnaround starts to bear fruit, with improving margins and resilient consumer spending providing fresh momentum.The company has stepped up efforts to revive growth, most recently under CEO Enrique Lores, as it struggles to sustain its pandemic-era popularity amid intense competition from Apple and Google and newer fintechs. We are making good progress in our multi-year transformation, Lores, who took the helm earlier this year after the board ousted Alex Chriss over dissatisfaction with the pace of change and execution, said in a statement. While there is more work to do, we are increasingly confident in our path to durable, profitable growth and remain focused on execution, he added.The payments company now expects full-year adjusted profit of about $5.60 per share, compared with its previous forecast and Wall Street analysts' expectations of $5.38, according to estimates compiled by LSEG.Adjusted profit came in at $1.45 per share in the three months ended September 30, sailing past estimates of $1.31.Revenue of $8.6 billion in the third quarter was a tad below estimates of $8.7 billion. Shares of the company fell 1.2% in premarket trading.REVIVAL ON TRACKThe company said it was on track to achieve $700 million in gross run-rate cost savings by the end of 2026, driven by cuts to more than 2,000 jobs and a reduction of over 25% in managerial roles.Efforts to streamline operations, optimize its portfolio and accelerate AI adoption, including using AI chat agents to support customer service, are also supporting the cost-management efforts, PayPal said.The company has set a goal of securing at least $1.5 billion in gross run-rate savings over the next two to three years.Adjusted operating margin, a key metric for investors, expanded 16 basis points to 18.8% in the third quarter.Earlier this year, Reuters reported, citing sources, that PayPal had received a buyout offer of $60.50 per share from Stripe and private equity firm Advent International, a bid that many analysts described as low-ball. The offer, which valued PayPal at about $53 billion, was reportedly deemed inadequate by the board and represented a fraction of the roughly $360 billion valuation the company commanded at its peak in 2021.SPENDING ENGINE KEEPS HUMMINGMore broadly, US consumers have continued to open their wallets despite economic uncertainty and sticky inflation, helping sustain spending growth across the payments industry.PayPal's total payment volume grew 7% on a foreign exchange-neutral basis to $487.1 billion in the third quarter.The year-end holiday season brings a crucial sales period for the payments sector, as retailers roll out eye-catching discounts and doorbuster deals online and in stores for Black Friday, Cyber Monday and Christmas.PayPal expects adjusted profit in the fourth quarter to come in at $1.43 per share, well above Street expectations of $1.35 and $1.23 a year earlier.

item.title: Boeing share price plummets with slower 737 production and free cash flow growth outlook
item.description: Boeing CEO Kelly Ortberg said on Tuesday that the company will not reach its 737 production rate target of 47 jets a month until early 2027, a serious setback to the company's ongoing recovery. As a result, the company will not hit its delivery target of 500 jets this year.
item.dc:creator: Dan Catchpole, Shivansh Tiwary
item.content:encoded: Boeing (BA.N) CEO Kelly Ortberg said on Tuesday that the company will not reach its 737 production rate target of 47 jets a month until early 2027, a serious setback to the company's ongoing recovery. As a result, the company will not hit its delivery target of 500 jets this year. The company also expects much slower free cash flow growth than investors had expected - $3 billion next year and $6 billion in 2028, compared to Wall Street analysts' consensus projection of $5.6 billion and $9.6 billion, respectively, according to LSEG data. Shares of the US planemaker fell 9.5% in early trading, reaching April 2025 lows, even as Boeing continues to recover from [USN:L2N3OO01G TEXT:"years of crises and controversies"] that dented its reputation, drained cash and saddled it with a heavy debt load. The company had planned to reach 47 737 jets per month [USN:FWN4240QK TEXT:"this past summer"], but it will take "into early next year," Ortberg said during an interview on CNBC. In September, he said that Boeing has not been able to make wings fast enough. Deliveries of the popular single-aisle jetliner are a major driver of Boeing's cash flow. "We are ramping up aircraft, and we're doing that in the right way," he said. Before Ortberg joined Boeing in 2024, the company had struggled for years with production quality problems that were attributed to rushing rate increases at the expense of quality. There is pressure on the company to increase 737 output faster, "but we're going to be smart about this, stay disciplined, and the outlook is there," Ortberg said. The company continues to struggle with production challenges in its 787 program and 777 freighters, as first reported by Reuters on Friday. High fuel prices have kept demand up for more fuel-efficient jetliners, but "certainly something we have to continue to watch," Ortberg said on CNBC. During the quarter, Boeing [USN:L1N4660X2 TEXT:"secured certification"] for the 737 MAX 7 from US regulators, won the US Navy's sixth-generation F/A-XX [USN:L6N45R0R4 TEXT:"fighter contract"] and generated free cash flow for another quarter, while certification of the larger MAX 10 followed in October. "Expectations are rising, and they should. We have a stronger foundation than a year ago, but we also have more work to do to deliver on our backlog, strengthen our culture, and improve how we work every day," Ortberg said in a memo to employees after the results. Boeing reported an adjusted loss of 34 cents per share for the quarter through September, compared with market expectation of 21 cents, according to data compiled by LSEG. Revenue at Boeing Commercial Airplanes dipped slightly to $10.7 billion, while operating loss stood at $697 million and margin shrank by just 6.5% compared with a contraction of 48.3% a year ago. The company attributed the performance to less profitable jetliner deliveries and higher production costs, including from its supply chain. At Boeing's defense division, higher deliveries, improved operational performance and a $252-million sale of a subsidiary contributed to nearly $500 million in quarterly earnings with an operating margin of 6.2%, up from 1.7% a year ago. Boeing Global Services earned $1 billion and posted an operating margin of 18.3%. The US planemaker ended the quarter with $25.2 billion in net debt, down slightly from $25.9 billion in the previous three months and $30.4 billion a year ago.

item.description: [２７日 ロイター] - 米自動車大手のゼネラル・モーターズは２７日、普通株式の上場先をニューヨーク証券取引所（ＮＹ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＧＭ、ＮＹＳＥからナスダックに上場先移管　11月17日から 10/27 20:32 配信

ゼネラル・モーターズのロゴ、デトロイトの新本社ビルで1月12日撮影 REUTERS/Rebecca Cook/File Photo（ロイター） [２７日 ロイター] - 米自動車大手のゼネラル・モーターズは２７日、普通株式の上場先をニューヨーク証券取引所（ＮＹＳＥ）からナスダックに移管すると発表した。

１１月１７日からナスダック市場で取引を開始する見込み。現在のティッカーシンボルは維持する。ＬＳＥＧデータによると、ＧＭの時価総額は約６４４億ドル。

ハイテク株の多いナスダックとの結び付きを求めて上場先を移す企業が増えておりＧＭも仲間入りをする。

ウォルマート、ヒルトン、パランティアなども最近ナスダックに上場先を移管、移管方針を公表している。

ポール・ジェイコブソン最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）は「顧客を中心に据え、技術を原動力とするＧＭの戦略は株主に価値を生み出している。成長を続ける上でナスダックは自然な上場先だ」と述べた。

ＧＭの株価は寄り前の取引で約２％上昇した。

item.description: [フランクフルト ２７日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）が２７日公表したデータによると、ユーロ圏の銀行融資は９...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ユーロ圏9月銀行融資、堅調維持　銀行の融資姿勢厳格化でも 10/27 20:24 配信

フランクフルトの金融街、2019年撮影 REUTERS/Kai Pfaffenbach（ロイター） [フランクフルト ２７日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）が２７日公表したデータによると、ユーロ圏の銀行融資は９月も堅調な伸びを維持した。金利上昇や地政学的な混乱を背景に、銀行が融資姿勢を厳しくする中でも伸びが続いた。

融資の伸びは企業向けが４．２％、家計向けが３．１％と、いずれも８月と同水準だった。

一方、ＥＣＢの四半期銀行融資調査では、住宅ローン需要が減少し、融資も受けにくくなるなど、利上げの影響が表れ始めていることが分かった。

第３・四半期に住宅ローンの需要が減少したと報告した銀行は、差し引き２７％だった。銀行の予想（マイナス１２％）や４─６月期の実績（マイナス１５％）を上回る落ち込みだった。

ＥＣＢは「金利上昇が需要減少の主因で、次いで消費者信頼感の低下と住宅市場の見通し悪化が要因だった」と分析した。

銀行は第３・四半期に住宅ローンの融資基準を厳格化しなかったが、企業向け融資と消費者信用では厳しくした。第４・四半期には全ての融資で基準を厳格化する見通しだ。

欧州主要国の中で融資基準の厳格化が最も顕著だったのはフランスだった。

ＥＣＢは「リスクへの警戒感の高まりと銀行のリスク許容度の低下が、引き続き融資基準厳格化の主因だった。一部の銀行は、地政学的な不確実性やエネルギーを巡る動向による圧力が強まっていると報告した」と説明した。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：ＴＯＰＩＸ銘柄入れ替え・比率変更、期日接近でリバランス活発化 アングル：債券市場の混乱やインフレ、為替変動がアジア系銀行を圧迫　収益と資本にリスク 焦点：主要生保の26年度下期、円債は入れ替え中心　金利上昇には最終局面の見方 焦点：米経済へのＡＩ効果、潜在成長率への波及は不透明 コラム：ＩＭＦが指摘する「薄氷のＡＩ相場」、日本も逆資産効果に備える時か＝唐鎌大輔氏 10/27(火) 20:24 最終更新 ロイター

item.title: 中国習主席、福田元首相の遺族に弔電 日中友好への貢献評価
item.description: [北京 ２７日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[北京 ２７日 ロイター] - 中国の習近平国家主席は２７日、２２日に９０歳で死去した福田康夫元首相の遺族に弔電を送った。

国営新華社通信によると、習氏は福田氏について、誠実さと責任感を備えた日本の政治家であり、中国人民の古くからの友人でもあったと述べた。

「（福田氏は）長年にわたり中日友好に深い関心を寄せ、正しい歴史認識を堅持した」と評価した。福田氏が日中関係とアジアの発展に果たした貢献を中国は忘れないと述べた。

「日本の現在の指導者が前の世代の政治家の努力を大切にし、中日間の４つの政治文書を順守して、両国関係の政治的基盤をしっかりと守ることを望む」と表明した。

item.title: Ares Capital to buy Apollo's MFIC in $2.6 billion deal
item.description: Ares Capital said on Tuesday it will buy Apollo's MidCap Financial Investment Corp in a deal valued at about $2.6 billion in stock and cash, strengthening its presence in direct lending to mid-sized businesses.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Ares Capital (ARCC.O) said on Tuesday it will buy Apollo's MidCap Financial Investment Corp (MFIC.O) in a deal valued at about $2.6 billion in stock and cash, strengthening its presence in direct lending to mid-sized businesses. Here are some details: • MidCap shareholders will receive $10.88 per fully diluted share, comprising about $1.21 in cash and $9.67 in Ares stock • Offer represents a premium of more than 30% to MidCap stock's Monday close • MidCap shares jumped over 23%, while Ares was trading flat • Ares Capital is the largest publicly traded business development company, managed by a subsidiary of alternative investment manager Ares Management • MidCap Financial Investment is a closed-end fund externally managed by a subsidiary of asset manager Apollo Global Management (APO.N) • Deal, expected to close in the first half of 2027, will give Ares access to MidCap's senior secured investments with "compelling" yields, and "modestly" add to core earnings, the companies said

item.description:
Olesya Astakhova Ahmad Ghaddar
[モスクワ／ロンドン ２７日] - 石油輸出国機構（ＯＰ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＯＰＥＣプラス、12月の生産目標据え置きへ＝関係筋 10/27 20:03 配信

ウィーンの石油輸出国機構（ＯＰＥＣ）本部、2024年撮影 REUTERS/Leonhard Foeger/File Photo（ロイター） Olesya Astakhova　Ahmad Ghaddar

[モスクワ／ロンドン ２７日] - 石油輸出国機構（ＯＰＥＣ）と非加盟の主要な産油国で構成する「ＯＰＥＣプラス」は、１１月１日の会合で１２月の原油生産目標を据え置く公算が大きい。関係者３人がロイターに明らかにした。最終決定には至っていないという。

オンライン会合にはサウジアラビア、ロシア、イラク、クウェート、アルジェリア、カザフスタン、オマーンの主要７カ国が参加する。

ＯＰＥＣプラスは２０２３年に当初合意した日量１６５万バレルの減産の段階的な解除を９月に完了した。ただ大半の加盟国を対象とする日量約２００万バレルの減産が２６年末まで残っている。

関係者によると、ＯＰＥＣプラスは２７年の基準生産量を設定する前に、加盟国の生産能力の検証を終える必要がある。基準生産量は今後の生産割当量を決める基準となり、残る減産の解除計画にも影響する。

イラン戦争による混乱で湾岸産油国の生産量は割当量を下回っている。

item.description: 防衛費増強、増税排除すべきでないとの声も 安保3文書改定の有識者会議 Reuters

item.title: 防衛費増強、増税排除すべきでないとの声も 安保3文書改定の有識者会議
item.description:
Yoshifumi Takemoto
［東京 ２７日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Yoshifumi Takemoto

［東京　２７日　ロイター］ - 政府は２７日、国家安全保障戦略など安保関連３文書の改定に向けた有識者会議を開いた。政府側の説明によると、安定財源確保のため増税も選択肢から排除すべきではないとの意見が出た。ただ、具体的な税目や防衛費増額の数値目標については議論されなかった。

有識者会議の開催は今回で５回目。政府側によると、防衛力の強化を産業力の向上につなげ、経済の好循環を生み出す構想については幅広い賛同が得られた。防衛省は、新たな戦い方の実現に不可欠な人工知能（ＡＩ）、無人機（ドローン）、宇宙、サイバー分野は、高市早苗政権が掲げる危機管理と成長投資の方針に合致すると説明し、防衛産業を強化するための法人を設立する方針を示した。

岸田文雄政権以降、日本は米国などの意向も踏まえ、防衛費の対国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）比を１％から２％へ引き上げた。米国は同盟国に３．５％の水準を求めているが、今回の会議では「防衛費は積み上げの結果だ」との意見が出た一方、明確な数値目標に関する発言はなかったという。

防衛費の拡充を巡っては、「防衛以外の安保経費がまぶされないように」との意見も出た。また、日本が新たな軍国主義に向かっているとの批判が生じた場合を想定し、対応策を検討しておくべきだとの指摘もあった。非核三原則の見直しや原子力潜水艦の保有については議論されなかったという。

政府は年内に３文書を改定する方針だが、次回の有識者会議の日程は未定としている。

item.title: Canadian stocks muted as energy losses offset gains in mining, tech
item.description: Canada's main stock index was muted in choppy trading on Tuesday as gains in mining and tech stocks were countered by declining energy shares, while investors awaited crucial monetary policy decisions from central banks due later this week.
item.dc:creator: Anand R
item.content:encoded: Canada's main stock index was muted in choppy trading on Tuesday as gains in mining and tech stocks were countered by declining energy shares, while investors awaited crucial monetary policy decisions from central banks due later this week. The S&P/TSX Composite Index (.GSPTSE) was down 0.1% at 35,897.12 points as of 10:28 a.m. ET (1428 GMT). The materials sector (.GSPTTMT) was the biggest gainer, up 1.3% as copper prices rose and gold reversed declines from earlier in the day Information technology stocks (.SPTTTK) were 0.2% higher, lifted by gains in data center infrastructure firm Celestica (CLS.TO) , though most other tech stocks declined Celestica (CLS.TO) topped the TSX with a 10% jump after [USN:L2N46C109 TEXT:"beating third-quarter"] revenue and profit estimates Energy stocks (.SPTTEN) lost 1.1% after oil prices turned negative, as markets balanced hopes that potential Middle East talks could ease supply disruptions against Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia's infrastructure "Oil prices going higher is a big driver of the energy component of the stock market, but that doesn't mean it's good," said Matt Manara, executive vice president and portfolio manager at Avenue Investment Management Reuters reported, citing sources, that the US and Canada are working on a [USN:L2N46C11U TEXT:"deal to ease US tariffs"] on Canadian steel as the two countries try to repair relations that soured after trade talks broke down in August "If they are able to ease tariffs and markets stay strong, that is good for capital markets, which translates into bank profits, which are 30% of the TSX," said Manara This week, attention will be on the US Federal Reserve's policy meeting, with the central bank widely expected to hold interest rates steady, according to CME Group's FedWatch tool The Bank of Canada meets on Wednesday, with markets pricing in a 78% chance of a 25-basis-point hike, according to data compiled by LSEG On Monday, financials and resources shares helped the TSX stage a rebound, with the latter supported by British Columbia's provincial election result, which raised production prospects for oil and gas companies

item.title: El dólar sube levemente a medida que la atención se centra en reuniones de bancos centrales
item.description: El dólar se fortalecía el martes frente a las principales divisas, entre ellas el euro, el yen y la libra esterlina, en un contexto de posicionamiento del mercado ante una serie de reuniones de los bancos centrales en las que se esperan nuevas pistas sobre las perspectivas económicas y la trayectoria de las tasas de interés.
item.dc:creator: Alun John, Chibuike Oguh
item.content:encoded: El dólar se fortalecía el martes frente a las principales divisas, entre ellas el euro, el yen y la libra esterlina, en un contexto de posicionamiento del mercado ante una serie de reuniones de los bancos centrales en las que se esperan nuevas pistas sobre las perspectivas económicas y la trayectoria de las tasas de interés. * La Reserva Federal tiene previsto anunciar su última decisión de política monetaria el miércoles, el Banco Central Europeo lo hará el jueves y el Banco de Japón cerrará la semana el viernes. * Se espera que los tres mantengan las tasas sin cambios, por lo que la atención se centrará en cualquier indicio que den los responsables a cargo de la política monetaria sobre sus perspectivas. * El dólar también se ha estabilizado tras sufrir presiones a raíz de la ola de ventas que afectó la semana pasada a las acciones de empresas de inteligencia artificial, que venían registrando fuertes subidas. * El euro bajaba un 0,25% frente a la moneda estadounidense, a 1,1144 dólares. * El euro va camino de ser la divisa de los mercados desarrollados con peor comportamiento en octubre, con una caída del 1,65% frente al dólar, lastrado por los elevados costos energéticos, la volatilidad de los bonos del Estado francés y las preocupaciones sobre la situación fiscal de Francia. * La moneda única amplió ligeramente su caída tras la publicación de la Encuesta Trimestral sobre Préstamos Bancarios del BCE, que puso de manifiesto que el impacto de sus subidas de tasas está empezando a hacerse notar. Si esa tendencia continúa, podría, en cierta medida, reducir la presión sobre el BCE para que continúe con las subidas de tasas hasta bien entrado el próximo año. * El yen fue una de las divisas principales con mejor comportamiento la semana pasada, apreciándose alrededor de un 0,75% frente al dólar, su mayor subida semanal desde principios de septiembre, ya que el nerviosismo en torno a la IA en el mercado de valores provocó una fuga hacia la divisa. * El dólar subía un 0,15%, a 157,73 yenes japoneses . La libra esterlina se debilitaba un 0,16% frente al dólar, a 1,3317 dólares. * El índice dólar , que mide la evolución de la moneda estadounidense frente a una cesta de seis divisas que incluye el yen y el euro, subía un 0,2%, a 102,22.

item.title: イスラエルの「スパイ企業」、スターリンクユーザー標的＝関係筋
item.description:
Raphael Satter
[ワシントン ２７日 ロイター] - サイバーセキュリティー企業トレンドマイクロの子会社...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
イスラエルの「スパイ企業」、スターリンクユーザー標的＝関係筋 10/27 19:34 配信

イーロン・マスク氏のシルエットとスターリンクのロゴ REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration/File Photo（ロイター） Raphael Satter

[ワシントン ２７日 ロイター] - サイバーセキュリティー企業トレンドマイクロの子会社「TrendAI」の専門家は最近、イスラエルの広告技術企業Discover-Techが米スペースＸの衛星通信網「スターリンク」 利用者を標的に「スパイ行為」を行っていた可能性があることを確認した。事情に詳しい関係筋６人が明らかにした。

Discover-Techはスターリンクサービスユーザーに表示されるデジタル広告の大手の１つで、これらの広告がユーザーの位置情報を特定するために使用されている可能性が高いという。

研究者らは、Discover-Techがスターリンクユーザーをターゲットとした広告の世界有数の入札者となり、スターリンク自体が禁止または制限されている国を含む１００カ国以上でスターリンクトラフィックの首位入札者になっていることを発見した。

スペースＸはコメント要請に応じなかった。Discover-Techもコメント要請に応じていない。

TrendAIは今月１５日にスターリンクユーザーが標的となっていることに関するリポートを公表したが、Discover-Techの名前は挙げず、代わりに「Shadow-Earth-７９」と呼ばれる「広告技術企業」が責任者だと指摘。関係筋６人によると、Shadow-Earth-７９はTrendAIがDiscover-Techに対して用いたコードネーム。

TrendAIは、なぜリポートでShadow-Earth-７９を社名で特定しなかったのかという質問には直接答えず、属性に関する自社のアプローチは誤りのリスクを減らすことなどを目的としていると声明で述べた。

TrendAIがShadow-Earth-７９に関するリポートを発表したのと同じ日に、カナダのサイバー監視団体シチズン・ラボとニューヨークの広告テクノロジー企業コンフィアントはDiscover-Techを名指し。両グループは同社が広告入札プロセスを悪用し、インターネットユーザーに関するデータを漏えいさせたと主張。漏えいしたデータを収集・照合して他の情報と統合することで、ユーザーの匿名性を解除し、ウェブ上での行動を追跡し、場合によっては監視ソフトウエアによる標的設定を行うことができるようになる。

シチズン・ラボとコンフィアントは、これらの広告がメディア組織、政府機関、テクノロジー企業が所有する数十の機密ネットワーク内で表示されていたと述べた。

調査を受けて、グーグル、コムキャストなどの企業は、Discover-Techを自社の広告プラットフォームから排除したと発表した。

関係筋の１人と、この件に詳しい７人目の関係筋によると、少なくとも米国の大手テクノロジー企業１社と１つの国際機関が最近、Discover-Techの広告が自社の従業員をターゲットにしていたかどうかについて、内部調査を開始した。

item.title: Fashion's AI era: face swaps and digital clones
item.description: LONDON, Oct 27 : AI-generated fashion models present a tantalizing opportunity for brands: the ability to create lifelike images for their retail websites while cutting costs by 90 per cent or more compared to photo shoots with human models.For the modeling industry, the technology poses an existential threat
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

Business

Fashion's AI era: face swaps and digital clones

FILE PHOTO: People walk past the L’Oreal booth during the World Artificial Intelligence Conference (WAIC) in Shanghai, China, July 17, 2026. REUTERS/Go Nakamura

Head of the British Fashion Model Agents Association (BFMA) John Horner poses for a photograph during an interview with Reuters, in London, Britain, July 2, 2026. REUTERS/Isabel Infantes

Head of the British Fashion Model Agents Association (BFMA) John Horner poses for a photograph during an interview with Reuters, in London, Britain, July 2, 2026. REUTERS/Isabel Infantes

FILE PHOTO: Fashion model Adot Gak poses as she arrives at the British Museum Ball, in London, Britain, October 17, 2026. REUTERS/Isabel Infantes/File Photo

FILE PHOTO: Clothing by Calvin Klein, a brand owned by PVH Corp., is pictured for sale in a store in Manhattan, New York City, U.S., November 30, 2021. REUTERS/Andrew Kelly/File Photo

FAST

LONDON, Oct 27 : AI-generated fashion models present a tantalizing opportunity for brands: the ability to create lifelike images for their retail websites while cutting costs by 90 per cent or more compared to photo shoots with human models. For the modeling industry, the technology poses an existential threat because of scant regulation governing the ownership or use of digital twins. Fashion models face the risk of unpaid replication of their image – or replacement by entirely synthetic models. To understand how AI is upending the economics of fashion modeling, Reuters interviewed 15 model-agency directors and reviewed more than a dozen confidential photo-shoot contracts in which brands including Diesel, Calvin Klein and L'Oreal detailed proposed terms for AI-created alterations and future use of the images. The companies’ contract requests included the right to swap a model's face with another using AI; the creation of a digital clone with no additional compensation to the model; and the right to use images of a model's body to train AI. The terms in the unsigned contracts also included broad legal language that could effectively give a brand leeway to use AI however it wanted.

While some companies are looking to repurpose or modify images of existing models, others are using fully AI-generated models, not based on existing humans. As AI use expands, modeling agencies are seeing bookings decline, photo studios are closing and models are facing the loss of a chunk of their livelihoods: photo shoots by fast-fashion retailers constantly adding new collections to their websites. "Within a year, even the next six months, there's going to be less jobs for models, especially our bread and butter, which is ecommerce," said Adot Gak, a model based in London who has been on the cover of Harper's Bazaar and appeared in campaigns by brands including Balmain and H&M. "If we don't speak up about this, in the next two years the whole industry will just be bots." While some fast-fashion players like Spain’s Mango have already rolled out AI-generated models at scale, high-end brands are moving more cautiously. Moncler experimented early with an AI-generated campaign in 2023, and Gucci caused controversy in fashion circles when it posted images generated by AI on Instagram this year.  Moncler said it does not currently use AI-generated models, either on its website or in its campaigns. Gucci did not respond to requests for comment.  "The scariest part is that now people cannot differentiate between a real model and an AI model," said Gak. FACE SWAPS AND 'DIGITAL TWINS' AI allows retailers to endlessly rework and redeploy a model’s image wearing different outfits at a fraction of the cost of new shoots.  "Some brands ask to modify faces, bodies, skin, age or expressions after shoots using AI. Others are asking about creating 'digital twins' of models that they can reuse later without needing another production," said Patrick Staal, owner of modeling agency Uniko Models in Barcelona. In a photo-shoot casting sheet, Italian brand Diesel asked models to agree to "alteration or reconstruction of facial features and body proportions,” along with “swapping of faces among the participating models,” and “superimposition of the Participant’s face onto another person’s body.” Diesel's parent company OTB told Reuters the model release was drafted for a specific campaign and isn’t representative of its typical agreements. It said it doesn’t systematically modify models with AI. Reale Actives – the skincare brand launched this year by social-media personality Alix Earle – uses the tagline, "Reale you is perfect you." But in a contract seen by Reuters, the brand asked for rights to create AI-generated replicas of models and to "own" and use these fakes for a year without further compensation. Reale Actives said in a statement that it uses real models and hasn’t replicated any model using AI. It said the contract language came from a partner production company, which it declined to name. MODELS TRAINING THEIR MACHINE REPLACEMENTS?  In some cases, models are helping to train their replacements: some contracts’ fine print includes language allowing the use of their images to train AI tools.  A Calvin Klein draft contract seen by Reuters asked the model to accept, for no extra pay, that the brand “may use reasonably unrecognizable images of Model (no identifying features such as Model's face, scars, tattoos or otherwise) to train and fine tune AI tools for learning general model attributes.” A Calvin Klein spokesperson said in a statement: "Like many others, we are testing and learning in this fast-moving space," adding that the brand's AI use is guided by regulation, industry standards and respect for models' rights. In many cases, contracts include wording such as "including" or "not limited to," which lawyers commonly use to claim rights that aren’t spelled out. Melanie Howard, partner and chair of luxury brands at law firm Loeb & Loeb in Los Angeles, represents both brands and talent in contract negotiations and said such sweeping language "is dangerous in its ambiguity” and makes it difficult for models to challenge any unsanctioned use of their images. In a photo-shoot contract seen by Reuters, France’s L'Oreal asked for "the right to use artificial intelligence (AI) technologies... including for the purpose of modifying, enhancing, or adapting the appearance of cosmetic products, packaging, or shades, as well as for retouching purposes." Without addressing that contract language, L'Oreal said it uses standard AI tools in post-production and editing that don't affect the model's image. 'WE ARE SAVING SO MUCH MONEY' Some firms are openly embracing AI to replace models and save money.  Europe's biggest online-fashion retailer, Zalando, has rapidly adopted AI-generated imagery for marketing content – and shut both its photo studios in Berlin last year. Fast-fashion retailer About You, which Zalando acquired in July last year, also closed its studio. Overall, Zalando cut more than 340 jobs, though the company said it retained some of those employees in other roles. Now, About You is launching its Scayle Studios business, which creates digital imagery for other retailers using AI-generated models and promises a more than 90 per cent production-cost reduction. Scayle has 130 brand clients and has generated 190,000 outfits in the last month, according to a company spokesperson. "We are saving so much money," said Julian Jansen, vice president of marketing at About You. "You've always had this super fast world of ecommerce, and this super slow traditional world of photo shoots, it didn't fit together in any way – and now with AI, it's a completely different scale." LITTLE REGULATION Regulations globally haven’t kept pace with the threat to models’ livelihoods, but the New York State Fashion Workers Act is one exception. The law has made it illegal since June 2025 for brands to create or modify replicas of models without their explicit consent.  "The misuse of models' images is not new, but with AI that problem is accelerated tenfold," said Sara Ziff, founder and executive director of the New York-based nonprofit Model Alliance, which backed the legislation. Ziff, herself a model for years, pushes for similar laws in other states and federally.  The British Fashion Model Agents Association has drawn up an AI code of practice, including that AI can only be used with the consent of a model, who would own any digital twin. But BFMA head John Horner said that without binding regulation in Britain or Europe, models still risk being taken advantage of by less scrupulous agents. "A lot of young talents don’t fully understand the long-term consequences yet," said Staal, the Barcelona-based model agency director. "Signing away AI rights at 20 years old could still affect someone ten years later."

Source: Reuters
