item.title: Who controls powerful AI? Anthropic has a plan for long after its leaders depart
item.description: Few public companies claim to have the future of humanity on the line while making mundane choices about board composition.
item.dc:creator: Jeffrey Dastin, Ross Kerber
item.content:encoded: Few public companies claim to have the future of humanity on the line while making mundane choices about board composition. Not so with Anthropic. Having warned that its artificial intelligence could one day cure cancer or kill up to 8 billion people, Anthropic has set up a complex plan for who can govern the company as its technology rapidly progresses, its [USN:L4N45L0EZ TEXT:"Monday IPO filing showed"]. Its expected [USN:L6N46118I TEXT:"$1.5 trillion valuation"] would make Anthropic the world's most highly valued public benefit corporation, a setup under Delaware law that means the AI lab must balance investor interests with promoting a wider good. More than fine print, Anthropic's setup may have big implications for investors and a public increasingly adopting the San Francisco-based company's AI. The details show how Anthropic has insulated itself from investor pressure so it can pursue what it says is best for humanity. Anthropic gave 50.1% voting power over certain matters to its seven co-founders, who, according to the filing, are "distinctly equipped to be stewards of our mission," [USN:L1N45K0N6 TEXT:"Reuters previously reported"]. Though an independent trust will control a majority of board seats, the co-founders' supervoting power will extend to elections of the remaining directors and shareholder proposals generally. The Monday filing revealed still more intricacies to overseeing a business that Anthropic expects will outlive the tight-knit crew that created it. Once most of its co-founders are out of the picture and their "Class F" supervoting stock is gone, Anthropic's board will divide into three similarly sized groups, serving three-year terms. Staggering directors' reelection like in the US Senate, Anthropic has embraced a structure once popular as a way to stem hostile takeovers. The company has long voiced concern about the risks of AI falling into authoritarian or nefarious hands. That structure also goes against some corporate-governance tides. In this century, major US companies have largely moved to electing all directors annually , making companies more responsive to shareholder demands on areas like executive pay or strategy. Anthropic declined to comment. 'LONG-TERM FLEXIBILITY' Beyond its board, Anthropic has another governing body with its own set of rules: its long-term benefit trust. Currently chaired by global health leader Neil "Buddy" Shah, the trust controls a special share class called "Class T" stock that will let it elect a majority of Anthropic's board. Anthropic has contemplated what happens if that stock goes away, too. The goal of such eventualities is to "preserve long-term flexibility if circumstances change," its filing said. Even if someone not bound by Anthropic's mission to benefit humanity takes hold of its Class T stock, Anthropic's setup would require directors to follow "provisions relating to our public benefit purpose." Ultimately, the trust's power over the board makes Anthropic a "controlled company" under Nasdaq rules, exempting it from following some typical requirements like having an independent nominating and corporate governance committee. Anthropic is using that exemption to put Daniela Amodei, its president and sister of CEO Dario Amodei, on that committee. THE LEADERS IN CHARGE Anthropic set up a safety and risk committee on its board as well, currently made up of Novartis CEO Vas Narasimhan and former Trump White House official Chris Liddell. Billionaire Netflix co-founder Reed Hastings is Anthropic's current lead independent director. Still, Anthropic's seven co-founders — the Amodei siblings among them — remain at the core of governance for the foreseeable future. This partly is through the existence of an entity called "Founder LLC," which, after the trust, will have the biggest say in board elections.

item.title: Centene lifts 2026 profit forecast, sees earnings growth continuing in 2027
item.description: Centene raised its annual profit forecast and said it expects 2027 earnings to be higher than this year, sending the health insurer's shares up 3%.
item.dc:creator: Sneha K, Padmanabhan Ananthan
item.content:encoded: Centene (CNC.N) raised its annual profit forecast and said it expects 2027 earnings to be higher than this year, sending the health insurer's shares up 3%. Higher medical costs in recent years due to elevated healthcare demand have squeezed margins for health insurers and prompted them to improve pricing and tighten cost controls. Centene has made great progress managing cost trends and improving its cost structure, CEO Sarah London said on a post-earnings call. The company expects 2027 earnings to grow from both its updated baseline of $4.70 per share and its raised 2026 adjusted profit forecast of more than $5.20 per share. Analysts expect a profit of $5.34 per share for 2027, as per data compiled by LSEG. "Investors may appreciate the positive expected growth trajectory, despite the uncertainty around the important Medicaid market next year," said Morningstar analyst Julie Utterback. The company has been facing Medicaid enrollment losses due to stricter eligibility rules, which have pushed some beneficiaries off coverage rolls, leaving insurers with a relatively sicker population that requires more medical care. States are opting for a more methodical approach to eligibility verifications, which should smooth membership impacts across 2027 and into early 2028, Centene said. Centene said costs in its Medicaid plans for low-income individuals were in line with its expectations, in part due to higher reimbursement rates from states. The company also said it was on track to breakeven in its Medicare Advantage business in 2026, a year ahead of expectations. COSTS IN CHECK Centene lowered its forecast for full-year medical cost ratio, a measure of premiums spent on medical care, to 90.4% to 91.1%, from 90.5% to 91.3% previously. Its third-quarter medical cost ratio of 92.7%, which remained the same as last quarter, was also better than its expectations. Analysts had expected a ratio of 92.84%. The company benefited from improved pricing in its Obamacare plans, established under former President Barack Obama's Affordable Care Act, as well as better performance in its Medicare Advantage plans for older Americans. Centene earned third-quarter adjusted profit of 58 cents per share, higher than analysts' estimate of 10 cents.

item.title: UPS CEO says delivery company will make more money on slightly fewer holiday deliveries
item.description: United Parcel Service raised its annual revenue and profit forecasts on Tuesday on better-than-expected third-quarter earnings after cutting doorstep deliveries of millions of unprofitable packages for Amazon.
item.dc:creator: Nandan Mandayam, Lisa Baertlein
item.content:encoded: United Parcel Service (UPS.N) raised its annual revenue and profit forecasts on Tuesday on better-than-expected third-quarter earnings after cutting doorstep deliveries of millions of unprofitable packages for Amazon. CEO Carol Tome said UPS' focus on more lucrative business means it can make more money delivering slightly fewer packages during its critical peak holiday season quarter every year. Shares of the world's largest parcel delivery firm jumped nearly 3% in early trading. Atlanta-based UPS expects total average daily volume to be down 1.3% in the fourth quarter as it becomes more selective in which packages it delivers. At the same time, executives forecast a roughly 3% rise in revenue in the company's domestic operation, its largest, and an estimated 7% increase in international revenue. "We're dispelling the old belief that all packages were created equal and that volume solves all problems," Tome told Reuters. A widening gap between the cost per parcel and revenue per parcel will improve margins, Chief Financial Officer Brian Dykes said. UPS' reduction in unprofitable deliveries — and the resulting lower volume reduction — in the fourth quarter means UPS can spend less on labor as well as truck and plane leases to handle the holiday package surge, Dykes said. Tome said the outlook for holiday delivery demand is strong as US consumers continue spending despite pressures from rising inflation and prices at the pump. "US consumers remain resilient," she said. SLIMMER OPERATION SETS STAGE FOR GROWTH UPS has shuttered facilities and shed thousands of jobs after scaling back deliveries for Amazon (AMZN.O) , its largest customer. UPS said it completed the Amazon scale-down in the second quarter. Rival FedEx (FDX.N) , which reports results on Wednesday, is using a similar strategy. Both companies have been under pressure from investors to improve margins by focusing on higher-value shipments. Tome also said data center construction is a significant opportunity as it touches every part of UPS, which can fly in critical components such as microprocessors, arrange ocean shipments of equipment, store goods and make final deliveries. For the third quarter, UPS posted adjusted profit of $1.69 per share, lower than $1.74 per share a year ago but above analysts' average estimate of $1.63. Third-quarter adjusted operating margin in UPS' domestic unit, which generates about 65% of company revenue, rose to 7% from 6.4% a year earlier. The smaller but more profitable international package division also reported a higher adjusted operating margin of 14.9% for the third quarter, compared with 14.8% last year. Jefferies analysts said third-quarter earnings showcased a "quarter of strong execution," while Evercore ISI analyst Jonathan Chappell wrote in a note that the results give "some confidence in durability." UPS also said it was on track to meet its target of $3 billion in cost savings this year. It has saved $1.8 billion through September. The company now expects 2026 adjusted profit of around $7.28 per share, compared with the $7.22 it had forecast in July. Analysts expect the company to report a profit of $7.19 per share, according to data compiled by LSEG. UPS expects annual revenue of $92.6 billion, compared with its previous projection of $91.2 billion and above analysts' estimate of $91.73 billion.

item.title: Last Republican incumbent senator in a Democratic-leaning state fights for survival
item.description: If Republican Senator Susan Collins wins this nail-biter of an election, it may well be because voters in Maine decide she is not Republican enough.
item.dc:creator: Andy Sullivan
item.content:encoded: If Republican Senator Susan Collins wins this nail-biter of an election, it may well be because voters in Maine decide she is not Republican enough. Since her first victory in 1996, Collins’ reputation as an independent-minded moderate has helped her win reelection even as Maine backed Democrats for president. Now the only Republican incumbent running in a Democratic-leaning state, she is deadlocked in opinion polls with Democrat Troy Jackson in a race that could help determine control of the US Senate. Democrats need a net gain of four seats to take control of the 100-seat Senate from Republicans in the November 3 midterm elections . Jackson, a rough-hewn former logger and state Senate president, has attacked Collins as a rubber stamp for Republican President Donald Trump . Collins is countering with the clout she has amassed over her 30-year Senate career, highlighting projects she has funded and carve-outs she has secured to lessen the [USN:L1N4680R7 TEXT:"economic fallout"] from Trump’s spending cuts, tariffs and war with Iran. “If it wasn't Susan Collins, this race would have been over three months ago,” said Maine Democratic consultant Toby McGrath. But strategists in both parties say the pool of the independent-minded, persuadable voters who backed Collins in previous elections has shrunk as partisan lines have hardened and Trump has galvanized Democrats in opposition. “If you hate Trump, you're voting for whoever the Democrats put on the ballot,” said Phil Harriman, a former Republican state senator. Democrats faced a potential debacle this summer, when Graham Platner, an oyster farmer and Marine veteran, won the party’s nomination [USN:S0N42B09J TEXT:"only to drop out"] after facing a rape accusation that he denied. The party quickly united behind Jackson, who has invoked his hardscrabble upbringing in the remote logging town of Allagash as he campaigns on a populist agenda of universal healthcare and raising taxes on the wealthy. “I saw at a young age how people with money and power and influence can hold people back,” he said at a campaign event on Saturday. $1.5 BILLION IN EARMARKS In recent weeks, Collins has visited projects she has funded through her work on the powerful Senate Appropriations Committee: a wastewater treatment plant in North Windham, a dock in Bucksport, an emergency center in Farmington. She says she has secured nearly $1.5 billion in earmarks since 2021. “This has required hard work, knowledge and seniority. The question for voters in this campaign is who can do more for Maine,” she said at an October 15 debate. That influence, she argues, has also helped to shield Maine from the Trump administration’s policies. As Trump’s [USN:L6N4580Y1 TEXT:"trade war with Canada"] has hammered the state’s economy, Collins has pointed to tariff exemptions the administration has granted at her request for road salt, cement and equipment used by the state’s blueberry, potato and apple growers. The Trump administration also credited her when it released home-heating oil reserves to try to drive down prices that have increased more than 70% since last year – a [USN:L6N461155 TEXT:"crucial issue"] in a state where roughly half of households rely on the product. Collins has also pointed to a $50 billion fund she crafted to help [USN:L6N3S70P7 TEXT:"rural hospitals"] cope with healthcare cuts in the 2025 tax and spending package that enacted most of Trump’s legislative agenda, as well as money for body-worn cameras and de-escalation training for federal immigration agents following the January killing of two US citizens in Minnesota. 'THERE SHOULDN'T BE A LIST' Jackson argues that these carve-outs amount to little when weighed against the damage caused by Trump. Body cameras and de-escalation training did not stop an immigration agent from [USN:L6N43H0SA TEXT:"killing a state resident"] in July, he says, and residents would not be struggling to heat their homes if Trump had not started the war with Iran, which has pushed up oil prices globally. Trump’s trade war with Canada, he argues, is only possible because Republicans in Congress have surrendered their authority over tariffs to Trump. “I can't believe that the most powerful US senator in the world would stand there and say, 'Well, I got this and this and that off the list,' instead of the fact that there shouldn’t be a list,” he said on Saturday. SIX ADS IN A ROW Meanwhile, a relentless ad war has played out over the state’s airwaves. AdImpact, an analysis firm, estimates $199 million will be spent on the race – equal to $170 for every adult in the state. During a local newscast on Friday, six ads in a row were devoted to the contest. Those ads are chasing a small slice of undecided voters. Democratic activists say they are encountering relatively few people who have yet to decide on a candidate as they campaign door-to-door in Windham, a Portland suburb that backed Collins by a 14-point margin in 2020, even as it backed Democrat Joe Biden over Trump for president. “There’s just a lot less of that persuadable middle than we historically see,” said volunteer Austin Coco. Windham resident Jim Tabor, a retired optician, said he has grown disillusioned with the Republican Party under Trump. A Collins supporter in past elections, he said this year he will back Jackson. “If he turns out to be a bum, I’ll vote against him next time. But Susan Collins won’t be there,” he said.

item.description: NEW YORK, Oct 27 : The crypto industry has spent roughly $176 million across more than 100 midterm races this election cycle, as part of a years-long plan to build a bipartisan coalition of allies in Congress that can advance its interests long after US President Donald Trump leaves office. The $2.75 trillio

item.content:encoded:

Crypto blitzes midterms with $176 million to support allies as it prepares for post-Trump era

FILE PHOTO: U.S. President Donald Trump delivers remarks at the White House Crypto Summit at the White House in Washington, D.C., U.S., March 7, 2025. REUTERS/Evelyn Hockstein

27 Oct 2026 06:03PM (Updated: 27 Oct 2026 06:19PM)

FAST

NEW YORK, Oct 27 : The crypto industry has spent roughly $176 million across more than 100 midterm races this election cycle, as part of a years-long plan to build a bipartisan coalition of allies in Congress that can advance its interests long after US President Donald Trump leaves office.  The $2.75 trillion industry, and the billionaires who built it, are aggressively spending to elect friendly candidates while targeting politicians they see as a threat, according to interviews with more than a half-dozen crypto political strategists and a Reuters review of the spending. While the industry’s recent spending blitz is known, its long-term plan to further its legislative agenda is less well-understood. The industry isn’t just looking for allies; it is trying to pick candidates who already have a chance of winning, and can help once they get to Congress, the strategists said.  Crypto's largest super political action committee, Fairshake, which spent $196 million during the 2024 election cycle, is leading the industry’s strategy again. Fairshake said 53 of the 58 candidates it supported in primaries or special elections this year won and will be on the ballot on November 3.

Super PACs can accept and spend unlimited sums of money, but cannot coordinate directly with campaigns. They are flooding several races with tens of millions of dollars in ads.  Voters have little way of knowing who pays for these ads, which barely mention crypto. Most of Fairshake's are sponsored by its affiliate PACs with innocuous names like "Defend American Jobs" and "Protect Progress." The ads often focus on hot-button issues like taxes or immigration. Perceived enemies, such as longtime skeptic Sherrod Brown, vying to return to the Senate in Ohio, can be subjected to an onslaught of often-personal attacks. Advocacy group Public Citizen said crypto was the single-biggest corporate spender in federal races in 2026, after saying in 2024 that its spending was "akin to a corporate Death Star hovering over elections."    The PACs' primary financiers, led by Coinbase, Ripple and venture capital firm Andreessen Horowitz, aren't trying to convince voters to support digital currencies. The money is a calling card to help forge long-term relationships with elected officials, said industry strategists, campaign staff, watchdog groups and political finance managers.  It underscores how the industry is behaving as other businesses do in Washington — using funds to open doors and buffer itself against regulation. The strategy reflects the reality that come 2029, the occupant of the White House is unlikely to be as personally invested in crypto as Trump, whose family made around $2.3 billion from crypto ventures between mid-2024 and April, a Reuters investigation found. “It's an investment in the future,” said Colin McLaren, head of government relations at crypto industry advocacy group the Solana Policy Institute, which has given $4.9 million to the midterms this year, according to campaign finance records.  The effort is designed to “ensure that over the next 100 years, the crypto industry has clear rules of the road, and that we know what our regulators are expecting from us," he said. Through October 20, Fairshake and its affiliate PACs have spent about $150.8 million on the midterms this year, while other crypto groups have spent around $25 million, according to campaign finance filings. "We back pro-crypto candidates who support American innovation in both parties, and look forward to continuing to build on the largest pro-crypto caucus in American history," said Geoff Vetter, spokesperson for Fairshake. COME A LONG WAY In 2018, lawmakers couldn’t even get a room in the House or Senate office buildings to hold the first congressional bipartisan roundtable discussion on crypto, instead meeting across the street from the US Capitol in the Library of Congress, said Kristin Smith, president of the Solana Policy Institute, who helped establish the Blockchain Association that year.  The Biden administration heavily scrutinized the industry following the collapse of FTX and an industry-wide meltdown in 2022, with the US Securities and Exchange Commission eventually levying more than $6 billion in penalties in 98 cases, according to a Georgetown University Law study.   “It was an all-out assault on the technology,” said Smith, the Blockchain Association's interim CEO. “The industry was in a corner, and the only way out was to show political force.”  Executives decided they needed a political strategy to combat what they called then-SEC chair Gary Gensler’s “regulation by enforcement,” lobbyists, advocacy groups and campaign strategists said. Coinbase Chief Policy Officer Faryar Shirzad was the architect behind nonprofit political advocacy group Stand With Crypto — which isn't required to disclose its donors — and Fairshake, which both launched in 2023. The number of Congresspeople with an "A" rating from Stand With Crypto is up to 332, compared with 96 when the group launched.   As the industry has won more legal clarity in Washington, its market value has nearly tripled from around $1 trillion in 2023 to about $2.75 trillion now, according to CoinGecko.  The combination of Trump, a growing bipartisan congressional coalition and a neutered opposition allowed the industry to advance its legislative agenda more in the last two years than some industries have done in decades, other industry lobbyists say. That includes 2025's Genius Act legislation establishing the first-ever US federal regulatory framework for stablecoins, enacted with overwhelming bipartisan support. That followed a White House meeting earlier in the year when industry leaders, including Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong and Ripple CEO Brad Garlinghouse, sat with Trump when the president declared an end to the "war on crypto."  "Moving that quickly in Washington is like light speed in space," said Ron Bonjean, partner at bipartisan public affairs firm Rokk Solutions, and a former senior Senate aide.  The industry's real goal is passing the Clarity Act, which would put crypto oversight under the Commodity Futures Trading Commission. That bill stalled in this congressional session and faces an uphill battle next year if Democrats win control of one or more chambers of Congress.  Without it, agency-level regulations undertaken during Trump's term can be reversed by a subsequent administration, analysts at JPMorgan said. Fairshake is financing House candidates from both parties, but it decided to only back Republicans in Senate races after Democrats in that chamber blocked the Clarity Act from advancing to a final vote. Their opposition centered around an ethics provision that would have forced the Trump family to sell their crypto holdings. Gary Kalman, of anti-corruption nonprofit Transparency International, criticized the bill for shifting regulation to the less-stringent CFTC, and for preempting states from enacting tougher laws. Coinbase and Andreessen Horowitz declined to comment. Ripple didn't return requests for comment.  THE PRIME TARGET Fairshake's highest-profile win in 2024 was defeating Brown, an industry foe who chaired the Senate Banking Committee from 2021 to 2024.  Spending millions attacking the sitting chairman of the industry's oversight committee was unprecedented in Washington, corporate watchdogs and political strategists say. But the gamble paid off.  Now, Brown is running again, with public opinion polls showing him with a narrow lead over his opponent, Republican Jon Husted. The industry has spent more than $68 million on the race, helping to make it one of the most expensive on record, according to AdImpact. Fairshake’s ads opposing Brown, which it did not comment on, don't mention crypto. One charges him with voting to raise gas taxes in Ohio and raises a Reuters-debunked claim that he voted to "unleash 87,000 IRS agents on you while voting to give social security benefits to illegals."  “Of course, the special interests are panicking, they know Sherrod will fight the rigged system they're feasting on to stand up for working Ohioans,” said Patrick Eisenhauer, Brown's campaign manager.  A CRYPTO MONEY BOMB  In some races, crypto spending dwarfed candidate fundraising. The industry spent $5.3 million in a Maryland House Democratic primary to support state Delegate Adrian Boafo, who raised $1.9 million on his own, records show. Other non-crypto groups spent $6.8 million to support Boafo's campaign, which declined to comment.  “There were so many ads ... that it makes other candidates suffocate,” said Quincy Bareebe, a healthcare entrepreneur who came in second of 24 candidates in that primary despite spending $6.6 million of her own money. "Adrian was everywhere."  The industry was less successful in Illinois. Fairshake spent over $10.1 million on ads attacking Lieutenant Governor Juliana Stratton, who is running for US Senate, and another $2.5 million against Illinois state Representative La Shawn Ford, who is running for a Chicago-area congressional district. Both are expected to win on November 3. Ford defeated a dozen primary challengers despite raising just $500,000 and lending his campaign $175,000 to fight off industry-funded ads that brought up a 14-year-old federal indictment that was later dropped. His campaign issued a cease-and-desist letter to Fairshake, accusing it of making defamatory statements about him in its ads. Fairshake did not comment on its ads or Ford's response. Ford thinks Fairshake targeted him because he supported state legislation to require crypto exchanges and related companies to register with Illinois. “They were relentless, on every outlet, radio, TV, social media, mailers," Ford said. “It was personal and it was hurtful, and unnecessary for my family to have to go through.”

Source: Reuters

item.title: フィンランドとノルウェー首脳、プーチン氏と会談 対話回避姿勢を転換
item.description:
Essi Lehto
[ヘルシンキ ２７日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Essi Lehto

[ヘルシンキ ２７日 ロイター] - フィンランドのストゥブ大統領とノルウェーのストーレ首相は２７日、ロシアのプーチン大統領と電話会談し、ウクライナ戦争の終結を促した。ロシア大統領との直接対話を避けてきた西欧諸国首脳の慣行から転換した。

今回の電話会談は、トランプ米大統領がロシア寄りに立場を変え、米国とウクライナの関係が過去１８カ月で最も悪化する中で行われた。

ウクライナ大統領の側近によると、ストゥブ、ストーレ両氏はプーチン氏と電話で会談した後、ゼレンスキー氏とも電話会談した。

ストゥブ氏はストーレ氏との共同声明で「（プーチン氏との）議論は率直で実質的だった。われわれはロシアの隣国だ。この戦争の結末は、われわれ両国と欧州全体の安全保障に直接影響する。戦争を終結させるには直接対話が必要だ」と表明した。ストーレ氏は「戦争は人的にも物的にも甚大な損失をもたらしている。苦しみと破壊は世代を超えて影響を及ぼす。電話会談では緊張緩和の重要性を強調した」と述べた。

両首脳はウクライナへの強力な支持を強調、支援を継続すると表明した。

＜ロシア側に妥協の兆しなし＞

ロシア大統領府が公表した電話会談の概要からは、プーチン氏に妥協する姿勢はうかがえない。大統領府は「ロシア連邦の正当な利益が全面的かつ無条件に考慮されて初めて、公正で長期的な平和の実現が可能になると強調した」と説明。

「同時に、欧州連合（ＥＵ）と北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）加盟国の対立的な政策が戦闘の長期化を助長していることにも注意が向けられた」とした。

西欧諸国の首脳は、ロシアが２０２２年２月にウクライナへの全面侵攻を開始して以来、対ロ制裁を積み重ねる一方、プーチン氏との接触をおおむね避けてきた。この姿勢により、終戦への取り組みをトランプ氏が主導する中、西欧諸国の首脳は協議には加わっていない蚊帳の外に置かれてきた。多くのＥＵ加盟国は、トランプ氏について予測が難しく一貫性を欠き、ウクライナを犠牲にしてプーチン氏に肩入れする傾向があると見ている。

こうした見方を強めたのが、今月の一連の取引だ。プーチン氏はロシア産軽油を米国に供給することに同意し、トランプ氏は対ロ制裁を緩和する一方、ウクライナ国民はゼレンスキー氏に代わる指導者を選ぶ時だと述べた。ウクライナはまた、米国による情報共有や、ウクライナ軍が依存する衛星インターネットサービスに支障が生じていると訴えた。

＜デンマーク首相、北欧２首脳の電話会談を批判＞

デンマークのフレデリクセン首相は、フィンランドとノルウェーがプーチン氏との対話を批判、ロシアが平和を望んでいる兆候は見られないと指摘。「欧州は個別に行動するのではなく、結束すべきだと思う」と語った。

ストゥブ、ストーレ両氏は、それぞれ自国の首脳として電話会談に参加したのであり、欧州全体を代表して発言したわけではないと説明。両国は長年にわたるウクライナ支援を継続するとした。

ロシアはこれまで、欧州各国政府がウクライナに武器を供与し、直接対話を拒むことで戦争をあおっていると繰り返し非難してきた。また西欧諸国の首脳の姿勢を、プーチン氏と対話し、これまでのところ成果は出ていないものの和平合意の仲介を試みてきたトランプ氏の姿勢と対比させている。

ロシア大統領府の関係筋はロイターに対し、プーチン氏と最後に電話会談したＥＵ首脳はフランスのマクロン大統領だったと述べた。同筋によると、２０２６年７月に行われた会談は公表されず、成果もなかった。

同筋は関係者によると、プーチン氏はストゥブ、ストーレ両氏に、ウクライナ東部ドンバス地域全域の掌握という目標についてロシアは妥協しないと伝えた。これに対し、両氏は「公正な」平和が必要だと応じたという。

ストーレ氏とストゥブ氏は先週、オスロでウィットコフ米和平交渉担当特使、ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領と会談。ウィットコフ氏はその翌日、ウィトコフ氏はサンクトペテルブルクでプーチン氏と会談した。ロシア大統領府はプーチン氏とウィトコフ氏の会談後、米国が仲介するウクライナとの和平協議を１１月に再開する意向を表明していた。

item.title: Big Tech earnings to test AI boom amid market turmoil
item.description: Amazon , Microsoft and Alphabet are expected to report accelerating cloud growth this week, but turbulence in global markets and mounting concerns over the cost of financing AI investments are clouding the outlook.
item.dc:creator: Aditya Soni
item.content:encoded: Amazon (AMZN.O) , Microsoft (MSFT.O) and Alphabet (GOOGL.O) are expected to report accelerating cloud growth this week, but turbulence in global markets and mounting concerns over the cost of financing AI investments are clouding the outlook. Investors are pressing for evidence that the AI boom can deliver swift returns to justify its enormous price tag. Rising bond yields at AI cloud providers such as CoreWeave (CRWV.O) and record costs to insure Meta Platform's (META.O) debt have amplified concerns about how the massive AI infrastructure buildout is being funded, particularly as higher US interest rates loom. Market turmoil has rekindled warnings of an AI bubble from investors, including hedge fund Citadel's founder Ken Griffin, and pushed companies [USN:L6N46216E TEXT:"to delay their IPOs"]. An expected Democratic sweep of the US midterm elections could spell more trouble for data centers that are already a target of protests over their impact on power grids, electricity bills and the environment. China's [USN:L4N4601U6 TEXT:"tech-stock boom has unravelled"], wiping out about $480 billion in market value in less than four months as concerns over AI demand and spending and Chinese export curbs deflate lofty valuations. The rout could be a warning for global markets. Big Tech's results this week will be a litmus test for AI adoption and economic viability. These three companies — with nearly $1.7 trillion in combined backlog — plan to spend as much as $600 billion this year. Meta's results last week showed just how unforgiving the calculus has become. Better-than-expected revenue growth and an upbeat outlook were overshadowed by increased spending plans, sending its shares down nearly 7% the following day. They are now down more than 4% this year. "The appetite for capital expenditure alone is slowing rapidly," said Brian Mulberry, chief market strategist at Zacks Investment Management. "For Amazon, Google and Microsoft specifically the growth in their cloud companies is a very important line item that will signal if further growth in capital expenditure can be funded without further risks of contracting free cash flow." While the trio's stocks have outperformed ad-driven Meta this year, with gains ranging from 1.2% to 10.1%, they continue to lag behind the S&P 500's near 12% rise. Google Cloud is expected to again lead the three major players in the September quarter, with revenue surging 95.1% to $29.57 billion, according to LSEG data. That would be faster than the 81.8% growth in the previous quarter. Amazon Web Services, the market leader in cloud, is expected to post 38.2% revenue growth on Thursday, up from 36.8% in the previous quarter. Microsoft Azure is expected to expand 47.7%, accelerating from 42% three months earlier, according to Visible Alpha data. Alphabet and Amazon are expected to burn cash for the second and third consecutive quarters, respectively, while Microsoft will likely generate more than $8 billion in cash flow. GOOGLE CLOUD SUCCESS, SEARCH CONCERNS Alphabet's cloud business and in-house chips have emerged as a bright spot in its AI push amid concerns Google's models are falling behind those of OpenAI and Anthropic. But competition from personal AI agents such as Meta's Muse as well as chatbots such as ChatGPT has raised concerns about the search business that has long powered its earnings. Google search revenue growth is expected to slow to 14.7% from 16.8% in the previous quarter, even as total revenue is expected to rise at a slightly faster pace of 25.2% to $128.18 billion. "This quarter, we believe commentary is equally important to quantitative results as competition for search is growing again with agents while there is increased consternation around the payback of AI capital expenditure," Citizens analyst Andrew Boone said. MICROSOFT CHANGES REPORTING SEGMENTS Microsoft will report under a revamped structure for the first time on Wednesday, combining cloud, AI and business software into a division called "Agents and Infra", and Windows, gaming and ad sales into another dubbed "Devices and Consumer". A notable change will be the disclosure of Azure's quarterly revenue, resolving investor frustration over its previous focus on growth rates without absolute figures. Analysts expect Azure to post sales of $33.06 billion in the quarter, powering a 16.7% rise in Microsoft's total revenue to $90.66 billion, slightly slower growth than the previous period. Amazon's overall revenue growth is expected to slow to 12.3% from 19.6% in the previous quarter.

item.description: [チューリヒ ２７日 ロイター] - スイスの金融大手ＵＢＳのセルジオ・エルモッティ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は２７日、...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＵＢＳ、外部ＡＩによる顧客代行の操作認めず＝ＣＥＯ 10/27 18:58 配信

スイスの金融大手ＵＢＳのロゴ。4月22日、スイスのベルンで撮影。REUTERS/Denis Balibouse（ロイター） [チューリヒ ２７日 ロイター] - スイスの金融大手ＵＢＳのセルジオ・エルモッティ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は２７日、外部の人工知能（ＡＩ）モデルに顧客の代わりに行動させることは認めないと述べた。

銀行業界では、高度なＡＩエージェントが金融システムに悪影響を及ぼしかねないとの懸念が高まっている。関係者によると、米大手銀行は外部のＡＩエージェントによる顧客口座へのアクセスを遮断している。

エルモッティ氏は科学関連の会議で「最近、一部の銀行では、顧客口座の管理や預金の移動、最適化に当たってＡＩモデルが不適切に動作するリスクがあるという話を耳にしただろう。われわれはＡＩモデルが銀行にアクセスしてそうした操作を行うことを認めていない」と述べた。

ＡＩについて今最も重要なのは、判断の過程が見えないまま顧客に影響を及ぼすＡＩモデルを使わないようにすることだと語った。

また２０２３年に買収したクレディ・スイスとの統合に伴い、ＵＢＳはＡＩの導入ペースをやや落とさざるを得なかったが、現在は技術に一段と注力できるようになったと説明した。

「統合がほぼ完了したことをうれしく思う。これにより技術をどう活用して銀行の業務の実効性と効率を高めるかに、さらに力を入れられる」と述べた。

ロイター 関連リンク 焦点：米経済へのＡＩ効果、潜在成長率への波及は不透明 コラム：ＩＭＦが指摘する「薄氷のＡＩ相場」、日本も逆資産効果に備える時か＝唐鎌大輔氏 アングル：ＡＩ関連の資金調達、低格付け領域にも拡大　投資家は警戒感強める コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず コラム：ＩＴサービス企業、生成ＡＩ追い風に株価上昇か 10/27(火) 18:58 最終更新 ロイター

item.content:encoded:
メルセデス・ベンツ、主力部門利益率見通し下げ　中国低迷などで 10/27 18:56 配信

メルセデス・ベンツのロゴ。2025年7月に撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic（ロイター） [２７日 ロイター] - ドイツの高級車メーカー、メルセデス・ベンツは２７日、中国における市場環境の厳しさが増していることや第４・四半期のコスト増を理由に、主力事業である乗用車部門の２０２６年利益率見通しを２─３％に引き下げた。従来は３─５％を見込んでいた。

グループ営業利益見通しも下方修正し、大幅な増益ではなく、前年比でほぼ横ばいになると予想している。

item.title: World to add less clean energy capacity this year, renewables agency chief says - Reuters
item.description: World to add less clean energy capacity this year, renewables agency chief says Reuters

item.title: World to add less clean energy capacity this year, renewables agency chief says
item.description: The world will add less clean energy capacity in 2026 for the first time in five years due to inadequate transmission networks and trade barriers, the chief of the International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA) said.
item.dc:creator: Sudarshan Varadhan
item.content:encoded: The world will add less clean energy capacity in 2026 for the first time in five years due to inadequate transmission networks and trade barriers, the chief of the International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA) said. Growth in solar and wind capacity has been accelerating every year since 2021, when the coronavirus pandemic disrupted global supply chains. Clean power installations including hydropower surged a record 692 gigawatts, or 15.5%, to 5,149 GW in 2025 — representing half the world's power capacity. Governments have pledged to boost clean energy use to ensure reliable power supply and cut costs, particularly after the US-Israeli war with Iran choked energy supplies and inflated prices. But IRENA Director-General Francesco La Camera noted that there has been a slowdown in renewables deployment in China due to curtailment — or rejection of clean power when a grid hits its limits. "The main cause of a lack of new record in additions this year is the mismatch between generation capacity and the capacity to distribute and transmit electricity," he told Reuters on the sidelines of the Singapore International Energy Week conference. China, the world's biggest renewable energy producer, turned away enough clean energy to power Mexico for a year in the first half of 2026, while networks in nations such as Australia and Japan also failed to keep pace with a surging renewables buildout. "The amount of the (capacity) increase in the other parts of the world this year, I don't think it will offset the slowing down in China," La Camera said. He declined to provide a numerical forecast for expected growth in clean energy additions this year. Renewable energy additions are crucial to reducing global emissions, and the United Nations said in a report last week that "urgent and stringent" emission cuts were required to slow global warming.

item.title: Football Accusé d'avoir offensé la Chine, Mbappé s'excuse mais perd plusieurs partenaires chinois
item.description: Kylian Mbappé, lâché par plusieurs entreprises chinoises après des propos polémiques sur le "dictateur" Mao Zedong, a tenté mardi d'éteindre l'incendie en présentant ses excuses et en marquant son "profond respect pour le peuple chinois et son histoire".
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Kylian Mbappé, lâché par plusieurs entreprises chinoises après des propos polémiques sur le "dictateur" Mao Zedong, a tenté mardi d'éteindre l'incendie en présentant ses excuses et en marquant son "profond respect pour le peuple chinois et son histoire". Dans une vidéo apparue en ligne lundi, on entend l'international français expliquer que le "mème" - une image ou une vidéo, souvent parodique, reprise massivement sur internet - le plus drôle qu'il ait vu de lui-même était celui où son visage avait été greffé sur celui d'"un dictateur chinois". A savoir l'ancien dirigeant chinois Mao Zedong. Les fans multiplient les mèmes superposant le visage du Madrilène à ceux de dirigeants militaires et politiques, suggérant son supposé autoritarisme. Fondateur de la République populaire de Chine, Mao Zedong est perçu par nombre de Chinois comme le sauveur de la nation et les plaisanteries à son sujet sont considérées comme un tabou. Il est mort en 1976. "Lors d'une récente interview, j'ai réagi à une image de moi me mettant en scène. Ce propos était maladroit, et je comprends aujourd'hui qu'il a blessé de nombreuses personnes en Chine et au sein de la communauté chinoise à travers le monde", déclare l'attaquant du Real Madrid dans un communiqué en français, chinois, et anglais. "Je présente mes excuses à toutes celles et ceux que mes mots ont heurtés. Ce n'était absolument pas mon intention. J'ai un profond respect pour le peuple chinois et son histoire, et je suis sincèrement désolé", ajoute-t-il. Dans un entretien accordé le mois dernier à L'Équipe, le Tricolore avait estimé que si certains aspects de cette tendance relevaient du simple divertissement, les mèmes viraux le présentant en dictateur traduisaient "un manque de conscience politique et humaine chez les gens". La controverse autour de la figure de Mao Zedong a pris une telle ampleur que plusieurs partenaires chinois du sportif ont manifesté leur réprobation en rompant avec lui. Ainsi Eastroc Beverage, qui utilisait l'image de Kylian Mbappé sur ses boissons, a déclaré sur le réseau social chinois Weibo s'opposer fermement à tout "comportement qui heurte les sentiments nationaux". "À compter de ce jour, nous mettons fin à toute coopération avec Kylian Mbappé", a ajouté la marque, avant le communiqué d'excuses du footballeur. Les groupes laitiers Mengniu et Milkground ont eux aussi mis fin à leur partenariat avec l'attaquant français. "MALAISE ET OFFENSE" Interrogé sur l'affaire, un porte-parole du ministère chinois des Affaires étrangères a indiqué que les paroles et actes portant atteinte aux sentiments du peuple chinois "se heurteront naturellement à un rejet commun de l'ensemble de la société". La télévision d'État chinoise a suspendu la diffusion de tous les matches et événements impliquant la Liga et Kylian Mbappé. Les publicités dans lesquelles apparaît le joueur ont également été retirées, a rapporté mardi The Paper, un média public chinois. "De la part de la Liga, nous regrettons profondément les déclarations de Kylian Mbappé qui ont provoqué malaise et offense en Chine. Nous comprenons le tort causé et, au nom de la Liga, je souhaite présenter nos sincères excuses au peuple chinois", a déclaré Javier Tebas, le président de la Liga, sur le réseau social X. "Depuis de nombreuses années, nous avons construit une relation de respect, de confiance et de coopération avec la Chine, ses autorités, ses institutions sportives, ses opérateurs audiovisuels et des millions de fans du football espagnol." "Nous ne pouvons pas permettre qu'une action individuelle ternisse cette relation ou nuise aux plus de 20 clubs engagés dans nos compétitions professionnelles et aux millions de supporters chinois", a-t-il précisé, ajoutant que la Liga prenait "toutes les mesures à [sa] portée". La chaîne de télévision publique CCTV a déclaré qu'elle écouterait ce que Kylian Mbappé a à dire après ses excuses et, "plus important encore", observerait ce qu'il ferait. "Nous espérons que la Liga, le Real Madrid et Mbappé lui-même tireront véritablement les leçons de cet épisode, présenteront des excuses sincères et corrigeront en profondeur leurs erreurs", a-t-elle indiqué dans un communiqué. La marque suisse On, dont il est l'ambassadeur depuis le mois dernier, a dit "[prendre] acte avec satisfaction des excuses de Kylian Mbappé". "Nous avons un profond respect pour le peuple chinois et le riche patrimoine culturel de la Chine. Nous restons en dialogue avec nos partenaires et n'avons pas d'autre commentaire à faire pour le moment", a-t-elle ajouté.

item.title: China boycotts Kylian Mbappe after perceived insult to Mao Zedong
item.description: CCTV has reportedly removed advertisements featuring Mbappe, stopped airing soccer matches involving the Frenchman and deleted all posts related to him from its official Weibo account ...
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded: French soccer star Kylian Mbappe is facing mounting backlash in China after comments perceived as insulting Mao Zedong, with state TV blocking his matches, social media freezing his accounts and a slew of companies dropping him as ambassador. CCTV has reportedly removed advertisements featuring Mbappe, stopped airing soccer matches involving the Frenchman and deleted all posts related to him from its official Weibo account. Chinese social media platform Xiaohongshu also froze the footballer’s account after controversy erupted over remarks he made while discussing an internet meme that appeared to depict Mao, modern China’s founding father.  Mbappe’s official accounts on Weibo and Xiaohongshu, which both have around 1 million followers, were marked with notices saying they had been muted for violating regulations.  During a press briefing, Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said that any words or actions that offend the Chinese people will inevitably encounter widespread opposition from Chinese society. Consumer brands that hired Mbappe as ambassador — Eastroc Beverage Group Co. and China Mengniu Dairy Co. — saw their stock drop. Shares of Eastroc fell as much as 4.1% in Shanghai, while Mengniu was down around 3% in Hong Kong. Both companies said they are severing ties with him.  Swiss sneaker company On Holding AG also deleted all Mbappe-related posts on its Chinese social media account. The sportswear brand did not immediately respond to a request for comment on its plans regarding its recently signed 10-year partnership with the 2018 World Cup winner. In a video, the footballer was asked which internet meme featuring himself had made him laugh the most. He described one involving a video of a man he said he thought was “a Chinese dictator,” with his own face superimposed on the figure. Mbappe said he frequently used the meme with friends while gaming online, but didn’t identify the person in the meme.  Taiwanese media outlet ETtoday reported that the image depicted Mao. Images circulating online also appeared to show Mbappe’s face superimposed on Mao. Neither Eastroc or Mengniu specified what prompted their decisions or referred to Mao in their statements.  Memes about Mbappe being a dictator have circulated at least since the World Cup this summer. It’s a nickname he’s carried for months and people have superimposed his face on several historical figures, often in military garb.  The episode quickly triggered criticism from nationalist users on Chinese social media, with some accusing Mbappe of insulting China and calling for a boycott. Prominent soccer outlet Dongqiudi said it wouldn’t provide a translation of his remarks as they were “hurtful to China and the Chinese people.” It’s not the first time that online controversies over perceived slights have hurt sponsorships and business ties. The National Basketball Association has worked to rebuild its brand in mainland China after a years-long fallout triggered by a social-media post supporting Hong Kong protesters in 2019 from Daryl Morey, then general manager of the Houston Rockets. Foreign companies including Swedish retailer Hennes & Mauritz AB and sportswear giant Nike Inc. have also faced consumer boycotts over comments on Xinjiang.

item.title: ユーロ圏の住宅ローン需要、金利上昇で第3四半期に急減＝ＥＣＢ
item.description: [フランクフルト ２７日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）が２７日に発表した四半期ごとの「銀行貸出調査」によると...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ユーロ圏の住宅ローン需要、金利上昇で第3四半期に急減＝ＥＣＢ 10/27 18:48 配信

販売中の新築マンション。2025年2月、アイルランドのニューブリッジで撮影。REUTERS/Clodagh Kilcoyne（ロイター） [フランクフルト ２７日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）が２７日に発表した四半期ごとの「銀行貸出調査」によると、金利の上昇を受け、９月までの３カ月間でユーロ圏の住宅ローン需要が急減した。

銀行の差し引き２７％が、第３・四半期に住宅ローン需要が減少したと報告。金融機関の予想（マイナス１２％）や前四半期（マイナス１５％）よりも顕著な減少となった。

ＥＣＢは「金利の上昇が需要減少の主な要因であり、次いで消費者信頼感の低下や住宅市場の見通しの悪化が挙げられる」と述べた。

各行は企業向け融資や消費者クレジットについては融資基準を引き上げたものの、住宅ローンについては引き上げなかった。第４・四半期にはあらゆる種類の融資について基準を引き締める見通し。

財政問題を巡って債券市場が混乱しているフランスは、欧州の大国の中でこうした引き締めが最も顕著だった。

ＥＣＢは「リスク認識の高まりと銀行のリスク許容度の低下が、与信基準引き締めの主な要因であり続けた。一部の銀行は、地政学的な不確実性やエネルギー情勢の推移により、圧力が高まっていると報告している」と述べた。

FAST

Oct 27 : Global stocks rose and oil prices slipped on Tuesday as investors weighed efforts to end the Middle East conflict ahead of US Big Tech earnings, seen as a key test of AI trade, and central bank meetings that could shape the near-term outlook for interest rates. Iran's supreme leader met with the country's security chief and discussed the importance of pursuing Iran's interests and implementing its conditions with the aim of ending the war, and the "no war, nor peace situation", state media reported. Diplomatic efforts were also under way, with representatives from Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan in Tehran.  Brent crude prices reversed earlier gains and were down 1 per cent at $114.74 a barrel while Europe's STOXX 600 index edged up 0.1 per cent and S&P 500 and Nasdaq futures were up 0.2 per cent and 0.3 per cent respectively.

In Europe, banks were in the spotlight as the continent's largest lender, HSBC, fell 6.7 per cent after missing revenue expectations for the July-September quarter owing to slower growth at its wealth business. Its pretax profit was in line with estimates. "Banks have been the winners of the latest quarter before this one, reporting record results because of high volatility and because of AI financing," said Ipek Ozkardeskaya, a senior market analyst at Swissquote Bank. "But right now, they are coming under pressure because we do see short-term yields rising more than long term; that's basically eating into the income revenue," she said, adding that banks are in a better position than sectors that are more vulnerable to rising costs. Quarterly earnings are the central focus globally as investors weigh up the impact of the conflict in Iran, including higher costs and interest rates, on corporate performance. EARNINGS DELUGE In the US this week, more than a third of S&P 500 companies are expected to report, and results on Tuesday pointed to a mixed bag. Companies such as Coca-Cola and economic bellwether United Parcel Service raised forecasts while reports from Hilton and JetBlue reflected rising costs resulting from the Middle East conflict.   The spotlight later in the week will be on AI hyperscalers including Microsoft, Amazon and Alphabet as investors seek signs that these companies' billion-dollar investments are yielding returns as expected. Microsoft shares slipped 0.8 per cent in premarket trading while Amazon and Alphabet registered marginal gains. "We remain medium-term bullish on the 'picks and shovels' trade. We see capex cycle remaining strong and the earnings remaining robust," said Jefferies economist Mohit Kumar. "However, we do admit that, as with any cycle, there would be winners and losers in the AI trade and a number of companies will not remain profitable and even go bust." Big Tech earnings could determine appetite for the eagerly awaited public debut of AI bellwether Anthropic and Meta Platforms' $95 billion equity fundraising.  CENTRAL BANKS EXPECTED TO STAY ON HOLD  Policy decisions from the Federal Reserve, European Central Bank and Bank of Japan are due this week, with economists expecting all three to stand pat on interest rates, leaving the focus on comments from policymakers to gauge the rates outlook. Fed policymakers have telegraphed that they will not raise short-term borrowing costs again on Wednesday, but with inflation concerns still front and centre, investors believe a rpause in rate hikes will not last for long. Traders are pricing in an increase from the Fed in December. The euro eased 0.2 per cent and at $1.114 it was near the May low it hit two weeks ago. The yield on the US 10-year Treasury note was steady at 4.974 per cent, staying below 5 per cent, which it breached in September as investors scurried to Treasuries for safety during stock market tumult over AI worries.  Spot gold eased by 0.1 per cent to $4,010.96 an ounce.

China to send envoy to Middle East in near future amid conflict spillover

Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun attends a press conference in Beijing, China, on Jan 7, 2025. (Photo: REUTERS/Florence Lo)

BEIJING: China is highly concerned about conflicts in the Middle East and surrounding regions and Beijing will send an envoy to the relevant countries in the near future, foreign ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said at a daily press conference on Tuesday (Oct 27). Guo called on related parties to resolve differences through dialogue and negotiation and also expressed concerns about the spillover and transmitting of the Middle East conflict to the Horn of Africa and the Red Sea region. "China will soon send a special envoy to visit countries in the regions to strengthen communication with relevant parties, promote contact and dialogue, help ease tensions and prevent the situation from deteriorating further," Guo said. Top officials from Saudi Arabia, Türkiye and Pakistan met Iranian officials in Tehran on Monday to de-escalate the Middle East conflict, as Yemen's Houthis launched new attacks on Saudi Arabia and Egypt approved defence support for the Gulf kingdom. Meanwhile, tensions between the US and Iran have sharpened recently with President Donald Trump saying last week that his country may strike Iran again. Last week, the foreign ministers of China and Djibouti met in Beijing, where they agreed that easing tensions in the Middle East is key to addressing security challenges in the Horn of Africa and the Red Sea.

item.title: アングル：ＴＯＰＩＸ銘柄入れ替え・比率変更、期日接近でリバランス活発化
item.description:
Noriyuki Hirata
[東京 ２７日 ロイター] - ＴＯＰＩＸの定期銘柄入れ替えや１０月の浮動株比率（ＦＦ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アングル：ＴＯＰＩＸ銘柄入れ替え・比率変更、期日接近でリバランス活発化 10/27 18:40 配信

東京証券取引所。4月6日、東京で撮影。REUTERS/Issei Kato（ロイター） Noriyuki Hirata

[東京 ２７日 ロイター] - ＴＯＰＩＸの定期銘柄入れ替えや１０月の浮動株比率（ＦＦＷ）変更が近づく中、指数に連動するパッシブファンドなどがポジションを構築する動きが改めて意識されている。銘柄入れ替えに伴う思惑は今月前半の正式発表でいったんの節目を迎えたが、入れ替え日の前日に当たる２９日の大引けにかけて、実際のリバランスの動きが強まるとの観測が出ている。

「買い需要が見込まれる銘柄が買われ、売り需要銘柄が売られるといったリバランス本来の動きが、今週入り後に加速しているようだ」とフィリップ・キャピタル証券の増沢丈彦株式部トレーディング・ヘッドは指摘する。

ＴＯＰＩＸの銘柄入れ替えを巡る思惑は、主要な証券会社各社による事前の推計を受けて、定期入れ替えの基準日となった８月３１日以降、織り込みが進んだ。１０月７日に正式な銘柄が公表されたことで、思惑に基づく売買は一巡したと市場では受け止められている。

実際、増沢氏が買い需要と売り需要が見込まれる銘柄群の値動きについて集計したところ、買い需要・売り需要が見込まれる銘柄群は、事前予想に基づく売買がみられ、その後の正式発表を経て、いったん出尽くしとなった様子がうかがえる。「ある程度、手垢がついており、あまり妙味はないのではないか」（しんきんアセットマネジメント投信の藤原直樹シニアファンド・マネージャー）との見方は多い。

ところが２６日以降、再び流れが反転している。ＴＯＰＩＸをベンチマークとするパッシブ連動資金を中心に「期日が迫る中で実需に向けたポジション構築の動きが本格化してきているものと推察される」（増沢氏）という。

数日分の売買代金に相当する資金移動のインパクトが見込まれる銘柄があることも要因の一つとみられる。例えば、新規採用の日本マクドナルドホールディングスは約１７日分と見込まれている。

今回の銘柄入れ替えやＦＦＷの変更では、売り買い双方で約４．８兆円のリバランスが想定されるという。買いはキオクシアホールディングス約９７４８億円、アドバンテスト約１９５５億円、リクルートホールディングス約１４７２億円、売りは三菱商事約２３９８億円、村田製作所約２３０６億円、三菱ＵＦＪフィナンシャル・グループ約１７７０億円などと推計されている。

こうしたリバランスの動きは、銘柄入れ替えやＦＦＷの見直しが指数に反映される３０日の前日２９日の大引けにかけて続く可能性があると増沢氏は話す。採用銘柄間の資金移動となるため、ＴＯＰＩＸへの影響はニュートラルとなる一方、ＡＩ関連の主力株で買い需要が見込まれており「日経平均の支援材料になり得る」という。

＜除外候補銘柄の動向に関心継続＞

銘柄入れ替えに関しては、２７年に向けた動きへの関心が継続している。「まだ間があるが、拾える銘柄を探していくのは面白そうだ」（しんきんＡＭの藤原氏）との声がある。

除外候補となった銘柄もすぐに除外されるわけではない。段階的にウエートが低減されながら、２７年１０月の再評価で継続基準を満たす銘柄はウエート低減が停止される。

基準日となる来年８月末に向けて、まず「ＴＯＰＩＸに残る意思があるかが焦点」と東海東京インテリジェンス・ラボの山藤将太エクイティマーケットアナリストは指摘する。

その上で、ＴＯＰＩＸに残る意思を示す企業は、株主還元などを通じて株価を引き上げようとするか、浮動株時価総額を引き上げるため需給悪化につながる売り出しなどに動くかがポイントになる山藤氏は話している。

item.title: Porsche mantiene sus ganancias mientras el 911 amortigua la caída de ventas
item.description: El fabricante registró un margen operativo de 6,9% en los primeros nueve meses, apoyado en los precios y la demanda del 911. Las entregas cayeron 16% frente al mismo periodo del año anterior.
item.dc:creator: William Wilkes
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — La rentabilidad de Porsche AG se mantuvo a pesar de otra fuerte caída en las ventas de vehículos, ya que la demanda de su modelo de gama alta 911 y de sus variantes de alto precio ayudó a amortiguar el descenso en China. El fabricante de coches deportivos registró un margen operativo del 6,9% en los primeros nueve meses, lo que supone un aumento respecto al mismo periodo del año anterior, en el que apenas se registraron resultados positivos, cuando los elevados gastos de reestructuración lastraron los beneficios. Según un comunicado emitido este martes, unos precios favorables y una gama de modelos más variada impulsaron los beneficios a pesar de la caída de los ingresos, mientras que la venta de activos potenció la generación de efectivo. Los resultados sugieren que Porsche está empezando a estabilizar sus resultados, incluso mientras reduce su actividad para adaptarse a un mercado estructuralmente más difícil. Ver más: Porsche apuesta por un superdeportivo más caro que el 911 para recuperar sus márgenes de beneficio El CEO, Michael Leiters, está trabajando para renovar una fórmula de beneficios basada en la fuerte demanda china, la elevada utilización de la capacidad de producción y un flujo constante de nuevos modelos lucrativos. Estos tres factores se han debilitado a la vez, mientras que los aranceles estadounidenses y los costosos cambios de rumbo de Porsche en materia de vehículos eléctricos han llevado a la división de coches deportivos de Volkswagen AG, que cotiza en bolsa, a realizar un gasto considerable justo cuando sus antiguos motores de crecimiento se desvanecen. Las entregas cayeron un 16% en los primeros nueve meses, lo que lastró los ingresos, a pesar de que los precios y la gama de modelos ayudaron a amortiguar el impacto. El beneficio operativo se recuperó notablemente con respecto al año anterior, cuando la empresa asumió elevados costos relacionados con su reestructuración estratégica. Porsche mantuvo sus previsiones para todo el año de un margen operativo del grupo de entre el 5,5% y el 7,5%, y unos ingresos de entre 35.000 millones de euros (US$39.100 millones) y 36.000 millones de euros. El flujo de caja también mejoró, gracias en gran medida a la venta de las participaciones de Porsche en Bugatti Rimac y Rimac Group. Estas desinversiones generaron unos ingresos de casi 1.000 millones de euros y reforzaron la situación financiera de la empresa. Las acciones de Porsche subieron alrededor de un 3,3% en Tradegate antes de la apertura de los mercados europeos. El 911 sigue siendo la defensa más sólida de Porsche. Las entregas de este deportivo aumentaron incluso mientras el negocio en general se contraía, y los compradores siguieron decantándose por las costosas versiones GTS, Turbo y GT. Esa combinación está ayudando a compensar la caída en China y las carencias dejadas por el Macan y el 718 con motor de combustión. Aun así, no puede compensar por completo las plantas y las operaciones de desarrollo diseñadas para volúmenes mucho mayores. La primera tarea de Leiters es reducir el tamaño de Porsche de cara a una época más difícil. La empresa tiene previsto eliminar más de 9.000 puestos de trabajo, reducir el número de directivos en un 40% y rebajar el volumen anual necesario para alcanzar el umbral de rentabilidad a unas 200.000 unidades. Asimismo, está reduciendo el gasto en desarrollo y concentrando los recursos en un número menor de proyectos más rentables. A continuación, Porsche pretende avanzar de forma decisiva hacia el segmento de gama alta. La estrategia incluye aumentar los precios de sus deportivos más exclusivos en torno a un 20%, ampliar la oferta de modelos a medida y orientados a circuito, e introducir modelos por encima del 911. item.title: インド・プライバシー法は事前検閲、報道機関が最高裁で訴え - Reuters
item.description: インド・プライバシー法は事前検閲、報道機関が最高裁で訴え Reuters

item.title: インド・プライバシー法は事前検閲、報道機関が最高裁で訴え
item.description:
Aditya Kalra
[ニューデリー ２７日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Aditya Kalra

[ニューデリー ２７日 ロイター] - インドのメディア団体は２７日、記者が記事で取り上げる人物の同意を得ることを義務付ける政府のプライバシー法について、事前検閲に当たり、報道機関の閉鎖につながりかねないと最高裁で訴えた。

ロイターは２６日、報道機関２１社が、同法は調査報道を踏みにじり、インド政府による記者の情報源の特定を可能にするとして異議を申し立てたと報じていた。

デジタルニュース出版社協会（ＤＮＰＡ）の代理人を務める弁護士は裁判官らに「ニュースとは何かという概念を根本から変えるものだ」と述べた。「許可を求めなければならないなら報道機関は閉鎖に追い込まれる。そうなれば完全な事前検閲体制だ」と訴えた。

報道機関側が今月初めに提出した書面によると、メディア各社は８月の政府との会合で、同法は報道の自由を守るとの確約を得た。しかし欧州連合（ＥＵ）やシンガポール、英国とは異なり、記者を適用対象から除外する規定が明文化されていないことに危機感を抱いているという。

報道機関側は２０２７年５月から適用される同法の問題条項の大半を無効にするよう求めている。同法により記事の削除を強いられる可能性があるほか、政府が報道機関に情報の提出を要求する権限を得ることで、記者の情報源が明らかになりかねないと主張している。

item.title: A Political Breakdown That Dare Not Speak Its Name
item.description: The most pressing policy question facing the US — how to restore fiscal control — has been conspicuously absent in campaigning for the midterm elections. Neither party is willing to frame a plausible way to solve the problem, so they’ve seemingly agreed not to discuss it. Their silence is an abject failure of governance. One wonders how much longer Washington will be able to get away with it.

The number of confirmed Ebola cases in Democratic Republic of Congo has risen above 10,000, government data showed on Tuesday (Oct 27), a milestone that coincides with growing fears the epidemic could spread to more African countries. The latest situation report from Congo's public health institute put the number of cases at 10,060, with those killed by the virus reaching 4,887. The outbreak, caused by the rare Bundibugyo species of Ebola, was announced in mid-May and has since become the largest and deadliest in Congo, surpassing a 2018-2020 epidemic. It is now the second-largest and second-deadliest on record behind only the 2014-2016 West African Ebola outbreak, which infected over 28,600 people and killed more than 11,000, mainly in Guinea, Liberia and Sierra Leone.

Earlier this month, Kenya reported its first case and went on to announce nine cases in total, after a man who had travelled from Congo via Uganda died in Nairobi. Last week, Nigeria became the fourth African country to report an Ebola case. Health officials have been seeking to work out how and where the patient - the wife of a Swiss diplomat, who had not travelled to Congo - contracted the disease. The Swiss government said she was believed to have contracted it in Uganda. The woman and her husband were flown to hospitals in Switzerland on Monday. Uganda reported 20 cases in May and June, mostly imported from Congo, but the World Health Organization declared the country Ebola-free in August. Ugandan officials say the country does not have any Ebola cases. Uganda's health minister said on Sunday that Ugandan citizens returning to the country with a history of travel to Congo would be quarantined for 21 days.

MOSCOW/LONDON, Oct 27 - OPEC+ oil-producing countries are likely to keep their December oil output targets steady on Sunday, three people with knowledge of the matter told Reuters, in line with expectations that further output policy adjustments are unlikely until next year. The online meeting of seven core OPEC+ members — Saudi Arabia, Russia, Iraq, Kuwait, Algeria, Kazakhstan and Oman — comes as Gulf members have been boosting exports that have been disrupted for months by the Iran war. Most, however, are still pumping well below their output targets. All three people declined to be named and said no final decision had been made. OPEC+ comprises the Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries and allies including Russia. OPEC and authorities in Russia did not immediately respond to requests for comment.

In September, OPEC+ completed the phased rollback of a 1.65 million-barrel-per-day supply cut first agreed in 2023. Disruption caused by the Iran war has meant Gulf producers are falling below their quotas. Reuters reported in July that OPEC+ was likely to make no changes to its targets during the fourth quarter as it turns its focus to 2027 quota negotiations.  The group still has one more layer of production cuts of about 2 million bpd covering most members through the end of 2026. OPEC+ needs to finalise a review of members' production capacity before setting the 2027 baselines that will determine future quotas and shape plans to unwind those cuts, sources have said.

Source: Reuters

item.title: ポルシェ、1─9月期に利益回復 事業再編の成果が表れ始める
item.description:
Rachel More
[ベルリン ２７日 ロイター] - 独フォルクスワーゲン傘下のスポーツ車メーカー、ポルシェは...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ポルシェ、1─9月期に利益回復　事業再編の成果が表れ始める 10/27 18:20 配信

ポルシェのロゴ。3月10日、ドイツ・ケルンで撮影。REUTERS/Jana Rodenbusch（ロイター） Rachel More

[ベルリン ２７日 ロイター] - 独フォルクスワーゲン傘下のスポーツ車メーカー、ポルシェは２７日、今年１─９月期の利益が回復したと発表した。ミヒャエル・ライターズ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が進めるダウンサイジング・中国再編計画が成果を上げ始めていることを示す初期の兆候だ。

高利益率のフラッグシップモデル「９１１」の売上高は１２％増。ポルシェのラインアップの中で唯一売上高が増加した。

ライターズ氏は「戦略的再編を一貫して迅速に進めている。焦点は、中核事業、競争力のあるコスト構造、そして収益性の持続的な向上にある」と説明。「すでに実施された措置により、長期的に見て、ポルシェをより力強く、的を絞った、収益性の高い企業として位置づけるための条件を整えている」と述べた。

同社によると、９カ月間の営業利益は１７億４０００万ユーロ。前年同期は４０００万ユーロと低調だった。

売上高営業利益率は２０２５年に過去最低の１．１％を記録したが、この９カ月間では６．９％に改善し、通年目標の５．５─７．５％の範囲内に収まっている。

item.title: Mbappe seeks to defuse China anger after 'ill-judged' Mao comments
item.description: France soccer captain Kylian Mbappe apologised to China on Tuesday after a fierce backlash over his comments referring to late Chinese leader Mao Zedong as a dictator, underscoring how swiftly global celebrities can come unstuck.
item.dc:creator: Casey Hall, Clare Jim
item.content:encoded: France soccer captain Kylian Mbappe apologised to China on Tuesday after a fierce backlash over his comments referring to late Chinese leader Mao Zedong as a dictator, underscoring how swiftly global celebrities can come unstuck. In a video on a French podcast that has since been taken down, Mbappe is heard discussing a funny meme where his face had been photoshopped on to that of "some guy — I think he's a Chinese dictator". "During a recent interview, I reacted to an image of myself," Real Madrid forward Mbappe said in a statement. "My comment was ill-judged, and I now understand that it hurt many people in China and in Chinese communities around the world. "I apologise to everyone my words have upset," added Mbappe, who has ties with firms including Swiss sportswear brand On Holding (49G.BN) , hotel chain Accor (ACCP.PA) and Lego. "This was absolutely not my intention" The backlash highlighted the risks for athletes and brands in the lucrative China market, where satire about Mao, modern China's founding leader who ruled the country from 1949 until his death in 1976, remain a social taboo. Other major organisations that have incurred the wrath of Beijing and Chinese netizens include fashion brand Dolce & Gabbana, Swiss watchmaker Swatch and the National Basketball Association. Some recovered quickly while others took years. "Mbappe's team knew, or should have known, what the true cost of Chinese brand endorsements was all about," said Terrence Burns, sports sponsorship expert and CEO of the T. Burns Sports Group. Swiss-based On Holding, which [USN:L4N45A12B TEXT:"signed Mbappe"] in September after he had spent two decades at US rival Nike, welcomed his apology and said it had "deep respect" for China. Accor did not immediately respond to requests for comment. Denmark's Lego, which has a Mbappe building set on sale in China, said it could not comment. The Mbappe set still featured on Lego's Chinese website on Tuesday. 'WHAT DID HE SAY?' Chinese state media outlet China Daily said Mbappe's remark had "triggered a backlash among his Chinese fans, threatened his lucrative commercial relationships and offered a sharp reminder of the limits of celebrity influence". "What did he say? Many Chinese would rather not repeat it," the state-backed Global Times added. "The message from Chinese consumers is clear: Respect is not optional; one doesn't get to profit from China while disrespecting it. Not a chance." On Chinese social media platform Weibo one user wrote about the apology; "Not accepted. Not forgiven!!". State broadcaster CCTV struck a more conciliatory tone, however,saying it would listen to what Mbappe had to say after his apology, and "even more importantly" watch what he does. "We hope La Liga, Real Madrid, and Mbappe himself will genuinely learn a lesson from this, offer a sincere apology, and thoroughly correct their mistakes," CCTV said in a statement. Real Madrid declined to comment. Brands including dairy companies Mengniu (2319.HK) and Shanghai Milkground Food Tech (600882.SS) as well as Eastroc Beverage (605499.SS) said they were ceasing all cooperation with Mbappe effective immediately. The companies said they "firmly oppose and have zero tolerance for any words or actions that hurt the feelings of the Chinese people." China's state television has halted broadcasts of all matches and events involving LaLiga and Mbappe, and all advertisements involving Mbappe have been removed, state-backed media outlet the Paper reported on Tuesday. Spain's LaLiga President Javier Tebas issued an apology on X and said his organisation deeply regretted the alleged comments that have caused discomfort and offence in China. "We are taking the measures within our reach and working directly with our partners and interlocutors in China to overcome this situation," Tebas wrote. "A relationship built over so many years cannot be damaged by a single episode." TRENDING ON WEIBO As of 0700 GMT, four topics related to Mbappe were still among the top 10 trending searches on Weibo. Some netizens called for China to blacklist Mbappe and reduce his commercial value to zero. These comments received hundreds of likes. Fans have been creating memes superimposing Mbappe's face on images of military and political leaders to suggest that he has the power to influence decisions at the teams he plays for. Mbappe has been nicknamed "the dictator" in the European press. "In attempting to laugh at himself and his reputation of being a dictator in the locker room, he apparently crossed a red line he didn't know was there," said Brian Jacobsen, chief economic strategist at Annex Wealth Management. In an interview with L'Equipe last month, Mbappe said that although aspects of the meme trend were harmless fun, the viral ones depicting him as a dictator showed "a lack of political and human awareness". A spokesperson for China's Foreign Ministry said words and actions that hurt the feelings of the Chinese people "will naturally be met with joint opposition from all sectors of Chinese society".

item.title: Two men charged in UK over RAF Fairford incident allegedly linked to Iran
item.description: Two men appeared in a London court on Tuesday charged under Britain's National Security Act following last month's security incident at the RAF Fairford military base, with prosecutors alleging one tried to assist Iranian intelligence in Britain.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Two men appeared in a London court on Tuesday charged under Britain's National Security Act following last month's security incident at the RAF Fairford military base, with prosecutors alleging one tried to assist Iranian intelligence in Britain. [USN:L1N45R08W TEXT:"RAF Fairford"] had been used by US bombers to carry out strikes on Iran, but they [USN:L1N45R04X TEXT:"were withdrawn"] on security grounds shortly after five British men were arrested outside the base in southwest England in the early hours of September 27. The circumstances of the incident, which remain largely unexplained, attracted huge international attention, coming at a time of heightened concern about the security implications for Western states of the war between the United States and Iran. Prime Minister Andy Burnham said earlier this month that the activity at RAF Fairford was likely to have been [USN:L8N45Y178 TEXT:"coordinated in Iran"], which [USN:S8N44X01J TEXT:"Tehran's ambassador to Britain"] has denied. British national Mohmed Abdulkarim, 24, was charged with engaging in conduct that was likely to materially assist a foreign intelligence service between August 31 and September 28. Abdulkarim appeared at Westminster Magistrates' Court alongside Nouman Essghir, a 24-year-old dual British-Iranian national who was first arrested outside RAF Fairford on September 27 and is charged with entering a prohibited place for a purpose prejudicial to the UK on August 22. SUSPECT CALLED POLICE Prosecutors said Abdulkarim, who was in a wheelchair in court, arranged for five men to take three vans and drive to RAF Fairford at the behest of a man called "Ali". The five men bought around £300 ($400) worth of petrol, which was stored in drums, prosecutor Louise Gray said. "One of them was told there was a bomb in the van ... (and) one of them called 999," Gray added, with police arriving shortly after. Gray said Essghir had conducted reconnaissance of the base on instructions from "Ali" in August, adding that he was also in one of the vans which drove to RAF Fairford the following month. After the five men were told there was a bomb, Gray said Essghir sent a message to "Ali" asking "wtf (what the fuck) is going on" but received no reply. Abdulkarim was granted bail ahead of his next court appearance in November. Essghir has been remanded in custody. Police said that six other people, four of whom are British nationals who were arrested outside RAF Fairford on September 27, remain on police bail. The decision to bail suspects after an apparent major incident had drawn scrutiny, but on Tuesday police said that decision had helped secure charges against the two men. ($1 = 0.7505 pounds)

item.title: 中国・香港株式市場・大引け＝下落、再びハイテク株に売り
item.description:
Jiaxing Li
[香港 ２７日 ロイター] - 中国株式市場は序盤の上昇から下落に転じ、１４カ月ぶりの安値で引け...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国・香港株式市場・大引け＝下落、再びハイテク株に売り 10/27 18:07 配信

Jiaxing Li

[香港 ２７日 ロイター] - 中国株式市場は序盤の上昇から下落に転じ、１４カ月ぶりの安値で引けた。域内の投資家心理改善を受けて一時上昇していたハイテク株に再び売りが出た。

上海総合指数は１．３％安の３６４８．３０と、２０２５年８月以来の安値で終了。ＣＳＩ３００指数も１．３％下落した。

深セン証券取引所の新興企業向け市場「創業板（チャイネクスト）」総合指数は３．４％安。上海証券取引所の新興ハイテク企業向け市場「科創板」５０指数は４．８％急落し、３月以来の安値を付けた。両指数は一時１．２％、０．８％上昇していた。

２７日のアジア株は上昇。人工知能（ＡＩ）関連投資の試金石となるハイテク企業の決算発表や、当面の金利動向を左右する中央銀行会合を控える中、ＡＩ企業アンソロピックによる待望の新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）申請がリスク選好を強めた。

ただ、中国のＡＩ関連株には売りが続き、ＣＳＩ半導体指数は５．８％下落して６カ月ぶりの安値を更新。ＣＳＩ人工知能指数も４％近く下落した。

ディフェンシブ銘柄で構成するＣＳＩ銀行株指数は１．３％上昇した。

香港市場では、ハンセン指数が０．７％安、ハンセンテック指数が１．５％安となった。

国金証券のアナリストはリポートで「最近の売りを受けた後、市場は短期的な反発を見せる可能性があるが、一部の過密なポジションがまだ完全に解消されていないため、中期的により持続的な回復にはさらなるデレバレッジが必要となるだろう」と述べた。

中国人民銀行（中央銀行）は２６日、大規模な解約に直面するノンバンク金融機関に緊急流動性を供給するため、スワップ制度の創設を発表した。

華金証券のアナリストはリポートで「ノンバンク金融機関の大規模解約に対応する制度の創設は、短期的な流動性を潤沢に保つことにつながる可能性がある」と指摘した。

９月の中国工業部門企業利益は伸びが加速したが、業種間の格差は引き続き顕著だった。

item.title: 物価動向を注視、タイミング逸さず必要な対応検討＝城内経財相
item.description:
Yoshifumi Takemoto
［東京 ２７日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Yoshifumi Takemoto

［東京　２７日　ロイター］ - 城内実経済財政相は２７日の月例経済報告関係閣僚会議後の会見で、足元の実質所得の伸びに比べて消費の伸びが力強さを欠いているのは、食料品などの価格上昇が要因との見解を示した。中東情勢による資源価格の上昇が徐々に物価に影響していると指摘し、今後も動向を注視し、予備費の活用を含めタイミング逸さず必要な対応を検討すると述べた。

また、人口戦略本部で有識者会議を組織し１１月６日をめどに初会合を開催すると発表した。メンバーは岩澤美帆・国立社会保障・人口問題研究所人口動向研究部長など１４人。

FAST

Oct 27 : European digital privacy advocacy group noyb filed five complaints against Scale AI in France, Italy, the Netherlands and Austria on Tuesday, alleging it illegally monitored freelance workers who produce training data for AI models. The complaints target Outlier, a platform on which more than 900,000 freelancers perform various tasks that are recorded to create AI training data for clients such as Meta, OpenAI and Google. Meta owns 49 per cent of Scale AI. Noyb is asking regulators to fine Scale AI and to examine how the platform assigns tasks. "You don't work when you want," said Thomas Le Bonniec, who spent two years studying the platform for Paris-based research collective DiPLab. "You work when the platform wants you to and there are tasks available."

Scale did not immediately respond to a request for comment. The complaints seen by Reuters said up to 19 trackers follow workers while they work, including recording keystrokes and mouse movements every few seconds. An investigation by DiPLab found the resulting file could be rebuilt into a video that replays a work session from start to finish. Workers must also submit ID documents and face video to identity verification firm Persona. The complaints said the checks were invasive, repeated without explanation, and broke EU rules on biometric data. Outlier also uses game-like mechanisms, and bonuses are a key part of its incentive system, DiPLab found. Outlier offered bonuses of $100 to $200 for completing 200 tasks in 24 hours, Le Bonniec said, citing interviews with workers during his investigation. Italy's data protection authority fined delivery platform Glovo in 2021 over similar gamification, he added. Four workers asked Outlier for copies of their data between December 2025 and May 2026. None received an answer, the complaints said.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 個人情報の不正窃取「卑劣で極めて深刻」、迅速に対応＝官房長官 - Reuters
item.description: 個人情報の不正窃取「卑劣で極めて深刻」、迅速に対応＝官房長官 Reuters

item.title: 個人情報の不正窃取「卑劣で極めて深刻」、迅速に対応＝官房長官
item.description:
Shiho Tanaka
[東京 ２７日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Shiho Tanaka

[東京 ２７日 ロイター] - 木原稔官房長官は２７日午後の会見で、ＦＸ（外国為替証拠金取引）がサイバー攻撃を受け、ＧＭＯインターネットグループの顧客情報がインターネット上に公開されたことなどについて、「卑劣な行為であり、極めて深刻」な問題であるとして、政府として必要な対応を迅速に行っていく方針を強調した。

ＧＭＯは同日午後、前週に同社のＦＸ自動売買サービスに不正アクセスしたとみられる攻撃者が、ＧＭＯおよび顧客に関する情報と称するものを公開したと発表した。

木原官房長官は、これまでにＦＸ業者５社が不正アクセスを受け、ＧＭＯに関しては「窃取された情報」がネット上に公開されていると説明。「国民の財産等に被害が及ぶ恐れがあり、極めて深刻に受け止めている。このような卑劣な行為は、断じて許されるものではない」と述べた。その上で、引き続き関係省庁・機関・警察当局と連携して状況の把握に努めるとともに「事実関係を踏まえ、必要な対応を迅速に行っていく」方針を示した。

ＧＭＯには、これまでに攻撃者から５０００万ドル（約８０億円）を暗号資産で支払うよう要求があった。木原官房長官は、要求に応じたとしても「攻撃者が約束を履行するという保証はない。また、犯罪グループの活動資金となり次の犯罪に結びつく懸念もある」として、警察などと連携し冷静かつ適切な対応をしてほしいと求めた。

政府は２６日にサイバーセキュリティーに関する関係閣僚会議を開催し、高市早苗首相は来週中をめどに緊急対策パッケージを取りまとめるよう指示した。

ＧＭＯではＦＸ自動売買サービスが不正アクセスを受け１９日から調査を開始、一部の利用者から身に覚えのない取引が行われたとの報告が寄せられ２２日に警察へ相談した。攻撃者からランサムウエア（身代金要求型ウイルス）攻撃の予告があったことを受け、期限となる２７日正午前にパソコンの電源を切るよう利用者に呼びかけていた。

item.title: Indian media groups decry Modi’s privacy law in court, say newsrooms face shutdown risk
item.description: NEW DELHI: The Indian government's privacy law, which would require journalists to seek consent from people they write about, amounted to pre-censorship and could lead to newsrooms shutting down, media groups told the Supreme Court on Tuesday (Oct 27), starting the most high-profile challenge against the legislation
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:

Indian media groups decry Modi’s privacy law in court, say newsrooms face shutdown risk

A general view of the skyline in Mumbai, India, on May 5, 2025. (Photo: REUTERS/Francis Mascarenhas)

27 Oct 2026 04:30PM (Updated: 27 Oct 2026 04:33PM)

FAST

NEW DELHI: The Indian government's privacy law, which would require journalists to seek consent from people they write about, amounted to pre-censorship and could lead to newsrooms shutting down, media groups told the Supreme Court on Tuesday (Oct 27), starting the most high-profile challenge against the legislation. The lawsuit comes amid accusations of declining press freedom in India since Prime Minister Narendra Modi took office in 2014. Critics say many mainstream media outlets have not done enough to scrutinise Modi’s government, which has denied such allegations and says it respects press freedom. A group of 21 news publishers, including companies owned by billionaires Mukesh Ambani and Gautam Adani, has challenged the privacy law, arguing it would trample upon investigative work and allow New Delhi to identify journalists' sources, Reuters reported on Monday. "It is changing the whole concept of what is news," Madhavi Goradia Divan, the lawyer for Digital News Publishers Association (DNPA) told the judges.

"Newsrooms will shut down, if we have to ask for permission ... it's then a complete regime of pre-censorship." The lawsuit is the most high-profile challenge to Modi’s privacy law. Until now, only free speech activists and a group of smaller news outlets had challenged it. The Supreme Court posted the case for next month. BIG MEDIA GROUPS VS MODI Media companies received assurances in an August meeting with the government that the law would protect press freedom, but not having a written carve-out for journalists like in the European Union, Singapore and Britain was alarming, the news publishers said in a filing earlier this month. The publishers are demanding that most of the law's contentious provisions, which kick in from May 2027, should be quashed. They say the law could also force publishers to erase stories and give powers to the government to demand information from publishers that could expose reporters' sources. DNPA, the group which has challenged Modi's government, counts as members Ambani's Network18, Adani's NDTV and other marquee media groups including the Indian Express and Times Internet, which is part of the Times of India group, publisher of India's largest-selling English-language daily. Divan said during the hearing that earlier versions of the law excluded journalists, but the final one did not.

Source: Reuters/ec
